There’s no such thing as individual success. We all need to play our part, contributing our skills and experience to make a true difference. That’s Howden.

## **Why work at Howden?**

We have always been employee-owned and driven by entrepreneurial spirit. Right from the beginning, we've focused on employing talented individuals and empowering them to make a real difference to the company, whilst building successful and fulfilling careers at the same time. Simply put, we hire talented specialists and give them what they need to make a difference for clients. Always have, always will.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down disappointed head-hunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work/life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

## **What is the role?**

Head of Data Protection Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance shall lead the Data Protection Function that is responsible for developing, implementing, embedding and maintaining a data protection control and oversight framework for Howden’s UK Broking (including its Specialty and Retail Pillars) and UK Reinsurance Divisions. The framework must be pragmatic, risk based and suitably robust to support Howden’s UK Broking and UK Reinsurance entities to meet applicable data protection legislation, including the UK Data Protection Act, but also any other applicable legislation in territories where those entities operate. The framework must also align to and complement Howden Group’s overarching Data Protection framework, governance and policy.

## 

## **What will you be doing?**

### ***Oversight & Change***

* Work closely with Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance senior leadership to develop and drive a data protection strategy that is aligned to the operating model and strategies of those businesses, promoting and supporting consistency of approach and application as much as practically possible.
* Develop and maintain an annual Data Protection Plan setting out the resources needed to deliver the projects and activities to be undertaken by the function, which shall be aligned to and support the regulatory expectations and objectives of the Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses (which may include their overseas operations).
* Support in developing and maintaining a data protection risk and control framework, including data protection policy, processes, procedures, controls and monitoring.
* Implementing a data protection horizon scanning process, ensuring any new or changing legislation is identified and implemented by expected timeframes.
* Produce reports and escalate data protection updates, risks, issues and compliance performance to the relevant Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance governance committees.
* Establish and maintain an effective data protection risk identification and escalation process across all Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses, ensuring swift and timely mitigation or management of risks and breaches.
* Develop, maintain and promote the consistent use of data protection tooling.
* Continually raise awareness of data protection and ensure adequate programme of data protection related training to employees.
* Oversee and manage any reporting to and interaction with data protection supervisory authorities, including the Information Commissioner’s Office.
* Ensure that all Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses have the correct data protection registrations and licences.
* Support in embedding a data protection by design approach within Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses.

### ***Stakeholders***

### Develop and maintain appropriate working relationships with the following to ensure that data protection issues are identified and proactive provision of appropriate solutions:

* Key senior leadership across the Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses to ensure a strong understanding of their current and future strategies, business models and objectives, to proactively pre-empt and recognise the data protection support they will require.
* Key operational and functional heads that are responsible for the development and delivery of operational processes and systems to embed a data protection by design approach and to support swift escalation of risks and concerns.
* Key information security leadership and functions, to ensure a clear understanding of information security processes and controls, and how these dovetail and work alongside data protection controls and risk mitigants.
* Internal Control Function Heads across the first, second and third line of defence, to develop an aligned and complementary risk, control and assurance framework, and to support addressing remedial actions.
* Group Head of Data Protection and wider group data protection functions to support an alignment of approach, ensure consistent upward escalation and reporting and to share best practice and common risks and issues.

  

### 

### ***Function responsibilities***

To develop, support and maintain a data protection function that is able to achieve the following for Howden’s UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses.

* Providing timely and considered advice and guidance on a range of data protection matters relating to Howden’s UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses, this will include, but will not be limited to – Marketing, DPIA’s, Subject Rights, Privacy Notices, Data Security.
* Supporting compliance with the UK Data Protection Act, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), other Data Protection Laws and the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR).
* Establish processes to monitoring compliance with the EU GDPR and other data protection laws, such as the UK Data Protection Act 2018, our data protection policies, including internal data protection activities, raising awareness of data protection issues, training staff;
* Providing advice on the conduct of and supervising data protection impact assessments (DPIAs);
* Completing a Record of Processing Activities (ROPA) that cover each of the in scope entities within Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance.
* Complete annual Data Protection Risk Assessments for Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance, ensuring that these are reported to the relevant governing committees, but that they also support and contribute to wider Howden Group Data Protection Risk Assessments and ERICCA.
* Support in the development and on-going reporting of KRI and KCIs that feed into the Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance risk management framework and, where relevant, Howden Group risk management framework and ERICCA.
* Having regard to the risk associated with processing operations and taking account of the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing
* Prioritising focus on the more risky activities, e.g. where special category (sensitive) personal data is processed, or where the potential impact on individuals could be damaging;
* Establishing clear points of contact for all BAU data protection queries from Howden’s UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses with regard to potential complaints and breaches, ensuring that data subject rights’ requests accurately handled
* Making available data protection resources, policies, procedures, guidance, training material and points of contact information in a way that is easily accessible.

  

### ***Team management***

* Develop and maintain a function with the appropriate blend of skill, experience and knowledge to deliver the data protection support and oversight required by the Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses.
* Implement an approach to employee development which enables employees to enhance their data protection, industry and Howden knowledge, experience and skill set.

* Manages (resource, motivate, drive, develop and focus) the team to ensure the required standards of performance are met; and that the professional and personal development of all team members increases their capability and effectiveness
* Promotes individual accountability through an ongoing performance management approach that aligns personal performance goals with the functional and wider business goals
* Ensures there are effective succession plans in place and actively develops team members to provide future successors
* Identifies and hires talent
* Manage (resource, motivate, drive, develop and focus) the UK data Protection Function to ensure the required standards of performance are met; and that the professional and personal development of all team members increases their capability and effectiveness
* Actively undertakes personal development to ensure up to date knowledge and understanding of best practice
* Develop and maintain appropriate working relationships with the following to ensure that data protection issues are identified and proactive provision of appropriate solutions:
* Key senior leadership across the Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses to ensure a strong understanding of their current and future strategies, business models and objectives, to proactively pre-empt and recognise the data protection support they will require.
* Key operational and functional heads that are responsible for the development and delivery of operational processes and systems to embed a data protection by design approach and to support swift escalation of risks and concerns.
* Key information security leadership and functions, to ensure a clear understanding of information security processes and controls, and how these dovetail and work alongside data protection controls and risk mitigants.
* Internal Control Function Heads across the first, second and third line of defence, to develop an aligned and complementary risk, control and assurance framework, and to support addressing remedial actions.
* Group Head of Data Protection and wider group data protection functions to support an alignment of approach, ensure consistent upward escalation and reporting and to share best practice and common risks and issues.

### 

### **What are we looking for?**

* Ability to provide risk-based advice.
* Experience in achieving stated objectives involving a diverse set of business partners and leading multifaceted projects.
* Negotiation skills to work effectively with key internal and external partners.
* Client relationship skills to continuously coordinate with controllers and processors while maintaining independence.
* Interpersonal skills to communicate well with a wide-ranging audience, from the Board of Directors to data subjects, from managers to IT staff and lawyers.
* Self-starter with ability to gain required knowledge in wide-ranging environments.
* Experienced within a Data Protection compliance field, to include building, implementing and managing data protection programmes within a sophisticated and enterprise-wide organisation.
* Experience with supporting marketing initiatives and the PECR regulations.
* Experience in handling data subject rights requests.
* Detailed knowledge of UK and European data protection law, and an in-depth knowledge of the GDPR.
* An understanding of technical and operational measures that should be in place to ensure the security of personal data and familiarity with information technologies and data security.
* Experience in compliance monitoring and risk management.
* Experienced in producing and presenting data protection reports to senior governance committees.
* Experienced in developing and delivering data protection training to employees of all levels.
* Financial Services experience preferred.

### **Compliance & Regulatory Responsibilities**

* Compliance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), UK Data Protection Act 2018, other UK data protection / privacy related legislation (such as the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations) and ICO guidance related to the tasks of a DPO.

### **Professional Qualifications**

* CIPP/E or Certified Data Protection Practitioner (PC.dp) preferred but not essential

A career that you define.

Our business succeeds by allowing our people to make a mark in the areas they care about most: personal development, volunteering, and fundraising for charity, or creating new insurance products that address society’s greatest challenges.

Job Description:
About Everest:
Everest is a global leader in risk management, rooted in a rich, 50+ year heritage of enabling businesses to survive and thrive, and economies to function and flourish. We are underwriters of risk, growth, progress and opportunity. We are a global team focused on disciplined capital allocation and long-term value creation for all stakeholders, who care deeply about our impact on communities and the wider world.
About the Role:
As the Data Protection Officer, you will play a critical role in developing, implementing, and overseeing our data privacy and protection initiatives. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, especially within our international locations, to ensure that our data handling practices comply with relevant regulations and industry best practices, while fostering a culture of data privacy throughout the organization. The DPO will oversee compliance with local data protection laws, including GDPR, to ensure that data protection controls are regularly tested, monitored, evidenced and enforced. This role will ensure that the risks to the rights and freedoms of data subjects associated with collection and processing of Personally Identifiable Information by European and UK operations of the company are regularly assessed and are minimized. 
Responsibilities:
Act in and fulfill the role of the Data Protection Officer for our international entities.
Serve as registered point of contact for the data protection authorities acting as the first point of contact for all inquiries.
Oversee the development and implementation of data privacy and protection policies, procedures, and guidelines globally and in alignment with applicable laws and regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA).
Monitor and assess data processing activities to ensure compliance with privacy laws and contractual obligations, including data transfer mechanisms and third-party data sharing agreements.
Conduct regular Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) or Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) to identify and mitigate potential privacy risks associated with new or existing projects.
Ensure that data subject requests such as data access, correction or deletion for individuals whose data is processed (EU and UK: employees, customers etc.), are managed and responded to within the required timeframe.
Oversee and advise on the implementation of data classification, data mapping and flows, privacy and protection and data retention controls and procedures.
Oversee and advise on incident response efforts in the event of a data breach, including coordination with internal and external stakeholders, timely notification, and remediation.
Monitor controls associated with the management, retention and disposal of records are maintained.
Report quarterly to Everest’s international boards regarding data privacy and protection compliance, control health and risk remediation activities.
Collaborate with legal, IT, and other departments to ensure that data privacy considerations are embedded in data processing activities, system design, AI initiatives, and data handling procedures.
Provide guidance and training to employees on data protection regulations and best practices to enhance overall awareness and compliance.
Establish and maintain records of data processing activities, including data inventories, data flows, and data retention schedules.
Monitor emerging trends and changes in data privacy regulations to ensure continuous alignment of policies and practices with evolving requirements. 
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Law, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
Professional certifications such as Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP) or equivalent are highly desirable.
5+ years of experience in data privacy and protection, with a strong understanding of relevant regulations and industry standards.
Experience acting as the Data Protection Officer and interfacing with data protection authorities.
Knowledge of U.S. and international data protection laws and regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and their implications on data handling practices.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex data privacy concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen attention to detail.
Experience conducting privacy impact assessments and managing data subject requests.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and collaborate effectively across teams.
Demonstrated commitment to staying current with developments in data privacy and protection.

You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Please let us know if you need any accommodations throughout the application or interview process.
Our Culture

## **About the role**

The Privacy Assurance & Compliance Specialist will manage and support the day-to-day delivery of Everway’s global privacy assurance and compliance programme, supporting the Director of Compliance in their capacity as Data Protection Officer (DPO).

The role will help ensure that privacy and data protection requirements are embedded into Everway’s products, systems and business processes and that privacy risks, controls and regulatory obligations are effectively identified, managed, monitored and evidenced.

Working closely with Legal, Data Governance, Information Security, Product, Engineering, People and other business teams, the role will provide practical privacy guidance and independent compliance oversight while helping Everway maintain a scalable and audit-ready privacy programme across evolving frameworks.

The role is focused on **privacy assurance, risk, governance and compliance**. Legal retains responsibility for contractual privacy matters and legal advice, while business and data owners remain accountable for the data and processing activities within their areas.**Main Responsibilities**

* Supporting the Director Compliance, to implement and deliver the privacy workstream of the compliance roadmap, ensuring the company meets its legal, regulatory and reputational responsibilities.
* Support and lead specific workstreams within the Compliance roadmap and business improvement projects/initiatives, for example data mapping, risk management, controls testing and policy development.
* Lead and coordinate Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) on products, systems, and processes, tracking risk treatments and embedding Privacy-by-Design from the outset.
* Manage the framework for Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs) and Data Deletion Requests, ensuring robust processes with system owners to assure quality and timeliness.
* Identify privacy risks and controls, translating them into practical business processes to improve organisational compliance and supporting incident management.
* Address privacy-focused vendor security inquiries from customers and collaborate with Legal on related requests.

* Conduct comprehensive internal Vendor Security Reviews to assess and mitigate third-party privacy risks.
* Develop, implement and maintain internal privacy policies, external privacy notices, procedures and ELT/governance reporting including KPIs.
* Lead privacy assurance activities supporting audit and certification initiatives (eg ISO 27701, ISO 27001, ISAE 3000, SOC 2) and manage central evidence within GRC tools.
* Monitor regulatory developments, assist with regulator/auditor interactions, and liaise with external and internal legal counsel as applicable on cross-jurisdictional privacy matters.

* 2+ years experience in a similar role in data privacy compliance or privacy assurance role, ideally within a software, SaaS or international tech environment.

* Ability to work independently and effectively manage and prioritise workstreams in a dynamic environment.
* Practical experience supporting DPIAs, DSAR/data deletion requests, ROPAs, incident response, and vendor privacy reviews.
* Proven experience translating regulatory requirements into clear, practical business processes and controls.

* Detail-oriented with strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

* Familiarity with GRC platforms (such as Vanta, One Trust)

Professional services is a core part of the FT’s global corporate coverage and this reporter will be expected to break news on the big strategy and IT consultancies, particularly McKinsey, Boston Consulting Group, Bain and Accenture, as well as contributing to covering the advisory operations of the Big Four – Deloitte, EY, KPMG and PwC.

---

---

---

You will combine editorial judgement, cultural awareness and strong relationship-building skills to identify compelling guests, manage the booking process and create exceptional experiences for guests from first contact through to release.

---

* Support the development of guest pipelines across UK and international recording blocks.
* Lead outreach and booking conversations with guests, agents, managers and publicists.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with talent representatives to improve access and opportunities.

* Coordinate effectively with production, research, post-production and communications teams to ensure smooth delivery.

* Participate in episode reviews and contribute learnings that improve future booking decisions.

* Longform producers know they can lean on you and get the support they need, when they need it

* You bring new ideas and techniques to the team and help raise the bar on how we make things

#### YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/
Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. Care increasingly happens somewhere else - in the field, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward.
Tricorder builds the deployable clinical infrastructure for that world: a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It is a dual-use venture serving defence medical and civilian pre-hospital care.
Our prototype product is already in user testing. Edge AI sits at the core: multimodal language models that turn video, sensor data and clinical notes into patient records, drive predictions and inform data-driven learnings across deployments. To trust those models in the field, we need rigorous data and evaluation - that's where you come in.
What you'll do
You'll own two workstreams, working day to day with the founder and the FF build team.
1. Data pipeline and evaluation harness
Build the data foundations that tell us whether our models are good enough for clinical use.
Data labelling: design labelling schemas and guidelines, set up tooling, and run labelling with clinical input, including quality checks and inter-annotator agreement.
Data processing: build reproducible pipelines to ingest, clean, de-identify and transform multimodal data (video, sensor streams, text).
Video data organisation: structure, version and catalogue video datasets so clips, annotations and metadata stay searchable and traceable.
Training dataset preparation: assemble balanced, well-documented train, validation and test splits, with clear lineage from raw data to model input.
Eval harness: build an automated harness that benchmarks vision-language and NLP models against clinically meaningful metrics, tracks regressions and supports build-vs-buy model decisions.

Database design: design the schema and stand up the data store for clinical concepts and their relationships.

Natural language processing: extract entities and relationships from clinical text and link them to coded concepts.
Document handling: parse and structure clinical documents (PDFs, notes, forms) into the database.
Clinical knowledge: work with clinicians to make sure the database reflects real-world clinical reasoning and pre-hospital workflows.
By the end of the first 3 months, we'd expect a working eval harness in use for model decisions, a labelled and versioned core dataset, and a first version of the knowledge base linked to the product.

The Engineering team at FundApps is a team of ca. 50 smart, friendly people who collaborate closely and take pride in delivering best-in-class software and providing an extraordinary experience to our clients. Our team values are professionalism, sustainability, and psychological safety; we hold each other to high standards, give each other considered and constructive feedback, work smart, and look out for each other. Learn more about our engineering culture here.

As part of the engineering team, you'll be working on a suite of innovative products that monitor over US$20 trillion in assets under management every single day, used by some of the world's largest Investment Managers. We are looking for a Mid-Level Back End Engineer who can help drive innovation and deliver great software at pace while also keeping sustainability in mind. We need highly motivated, intelligent people hungry for a challenge.

At FundApps, you'll see the inner workings of a fast-growing, bootstrapped scaleup where we expect all Engineers to take responsibility for their part in our success, seek support when needed, and care equally about our products and client outcomes as you do about writing code. We solve business problems through technology, not just ship code.

We are hiring a Clinical Research Interface (CRI) Manager to provide coordination support and management  of the CRI.

The CRI provides a critical link between the Research Network working with data available in the National Genomic Research Library, Genomics England and NHS clinical teams caring for patients.

The role will involve working with the relevant teams at Genomics England and external stakeholders to maximise the impact of genomic findings for participants and patients. This includes returning putative diagnostic findings to the NHS, initiating collaborations between researchers and NHS clinicians to further research and linking participants with potential therapeutic opportunities.

As CRI Manager, you will oversee the logistical processes required to support the Diagnostic Discovery pathway and facilitate research collaborations, bringing together researchers, clinicians, diagnostic laboratories, and internal teams.

* Building strong partnerships with researchers, clinicians, laboratory scientists, and other stakeholders to facilitate collaboration and decision-making.
* Ensuring robust governance processes are followed when handling sensitive patient information and research findings.
* Identifying opportunities to improve processes, workflows, and operational efficiency across the pathway.

* Extensive experience in healthcare, clinical research, life sciences or precision medicine.

# Interim Group Financial Controller / Finance Stabilisation Lead

Fintech Enterprise Finance CompanyPosted about 4 hours ago

12-week Interim Group Financial Controller to stabilise reporting, remediate the month-end close, and deliver forecasts for a mid-market fintech enterprise

Location

🇬🇧England, United Kingdom

Remote

Hours

25-40 hrs/week

FinanceAccount ReconciliationFinancial ReportingUS GAAP

## Job Description

The company is an established fintech and enterprise-software business with an international corporate structure, using Microsoft Dynamics as its accounting system. Following the departure of the Financial Controller, we require an experienced, hands-on interim Group Financial Controller / Finance Stabilisation Lead to restore confidence in financial reporting, strengthen the month-end close, and deliver decision-ready forecasts. This role reports to the CEO, will work closely with a junior accountant, and is UK-preferred (strong US candidates considered if they can maintain substantial overlap with UK hours). Initial term: approximately three months with an option to extend; initial commitment about 3–4 days per week (roughly 30–40 hours), tapering thereafter.

# Responsibilities

## Financial validation and remediation

* Assess the accuracy and completeness of the group’s accounting records.
* Validate closing and opening balances across the most recent fiscal years.
* Review and correct year-to-date financial results.
* Establish reliable entity-level and consolidated trial balances.
* Identify misclassifications, unsupported balances and incomplete accounting.
* Maintain a documented adjustment and remediation log.
* Quantify unresolved issues and communicate their potential impact clearly.

## Reconciliations and close

* Complete or supervise reconciliations for bank and credit-card accounts; accounts receivable and accounts payable; payroll, benefits and payroll taxes; deferred and unbilled revenue; accruals and prepayments; fixed assets; taxes (VAT/GST and sales tax); intercompany accounts; debt, equity and retained earnings.
* Reconcile subledgers and supporting schedules to the general ledger.
* Establish a documented month-end close calendar and checklist.
* Introduce appropriate journal, reconciliation and management-review controls.
* Reduce the recurring close timetable to around two weeks.

## Technical accounting and consolidation

* Review revenue-recognition practices and supporting schedules.
* Document treatment of foreign currency, intercompany transactions and consolidation entries.
* Produce reliable consolidated P&L, balance-sheet and cash-flow statements.
* Coordinate with external tax, statutory reporting and audit advisers as required.
* Identify issues that may affect prior statutory filings or require deeper historical review.

## Forecasting and management reporting

* Produce an initial short-term (e.g., 13-week) cash forecast early in the assignment.
* Build an integrated reforecast for the current fiscal year and a monthly budget for the following year (monthly P&L, balance sheet and cash flow).
* Develop base, downside and upside scenarios; model revenue, customer contracts, renewals, headcount, collections, operating expenditure, tax, capital expenditure and foreign exchange.
* Establish an actual-to-forecast reporting process.
* Create a concise monthly KPI and management-reporting pack; ensure each KPI has a clear definition, source and owner.

## Team development and permanent structure

* Coach and develop the junior accountant; assess their readiness to operate as an acting controller.
* Identify transactional work to reassign or outsource.
* Recommend whether the organization should hire a permanent full-time Financial Controller or appoint a fractional CFO and develop the junior accountant as acting controller.
* Prepare a complete handover package for the permanent finance leader.

## Deliverables and cadence (examples)

* First 2–3 weeks: finance risk and remediation register; reconciled cash position; assessment of immediate payroll, tax, AP and collection risks; preliminary fiscal outlook; initial short-term cash forecast; close-process assessment; prioritised short-term workplan.
* Around month 1: status assessment for every material balance-sheet account; reconciliation and adjustment tracker; preliminary corrected year-to-date financial statements; documented historical-validation boundary; initial junior-accountant skills assessment.
* By month 2: validated entity-level trial balances; corrected and consolidated year-to-date financial statements; completed material balance-sheet reconciliation files; integrated reforecast and monthly budget with scenario analysis; revenue-recognition, intercompany and FX documentation; initial KPI and management-reporting pack.
* By month 3: two controlled month-end closes completed or substantially demonstrated (close and reporting operating to the agreed timetable); finalised accounting procedures, account ownership and control documentation; final junior-accountant readiness assessment; recommendation for permanent finance organisation; complete handover materials.

# Qualifications

## Mandatory

* CPA, ACA, ACCA, CA or equivalent accounting qualification.
* Prior experience as a Group Financial Controller, Financial Controller, hands-on Finance Director or comparable leader.
* Demonstrated success repairing unreliable financials or remediating a broken close.
* Strong US GAAP knowledge, including revenue recognition.
* Multi-entity and multi-currency consolidation experience; experience working with international subsidiaries.
* Strong balance-sheet reconciliation and accounting-control skills.
* Ability to build integrated P&L, balance-sheet and cash-flow forecasts.
* Hands-on ERP and financial-data skills; willingness to work directly in Microsoft Dynamics, spreadsheets and reconciliation files.
* Ability to communicate financial uncertainty, risks and recommendations clearly to a CEO.
* Demonstrated ability to coach and review the work of less-experienced accountants.

## Preferred

* Direct Microsoft Dynamics experience.
* Experience with a parent company and multiple international subsidiaries.
* Fintech, enterprise software, SaaS or B2B technology experience.
* Experience at companies of comparable scale.
* Experience with revenue arrangements involving licences, subscriptions, services or complex customer contracts.
* Prior audit remediation, finance transformation or interim-controller assignments.
* Experience transitioning an engagement to a permanent controller or fractional-CFO structure.

# Candidate profile

* Comfortable moving between detailed accounting work and CEO-level communication.
* Pragmatic, organised and appropriately sceptical; investigates discrepancies rather than carrying them forward.
* Will personally own the quality and delivery of the work and will not delegate full remediation to the junior accountant.

## About the Company

* A small-to-midsize fintech and enterprise-finance software company operating internationally.
* Focused on strengthening corporate finance, reporting and forecasting to support continued cross-border growth.

# Power Integrity Engineer

Bristol, UK

## About the job

Shape the power delivery that will make Graphcore’s next-generation AI compute systems reliable.

As a Power Integrity Engineer, you will analyse power-delivery networks across silicon, package and PCB, turning complex behaviour into practical design recommendations.

You will build PDN models, investigate parasitics, and use frequency-domain and time-domain analysis to understand stability, droop, resonances and transient response. Your work will directly inform decoupling, layout, and power and ground distribution choices.

You will use electromagnetic simulation to understand resistance, inductance, coupling and impedance. You will also validate assumptions, identify technical risks, and connect simulation results with hardware measurements.

You will start with clearly scoped PI problems, supported by experienced engineers when wider decisions are involved. As your capability grows, you will own larger parts of the PDN.

## The team and culture

You will work alongside experienced PI engineers and colleagues across hardware disciplines, connecting analysis with real design decisions and measurements.

You will own defined technical problems and move quickly from modelling to recommendations. Decisions are grounded in evidence, physical understanding and clear communication of uncertainty.

You will contribute to design reviews, speak up when results expose risk, and take responsibility for the quality of your analysis.

## What we’re looking for

* Build, integrate and analyse PDN models for defined power rails, package structures, PCB designs or subsystems.
* Use frequency-domain impedance analysis and time-domain simulation to investigate voltage stability, droop, resonances and transient response.
* Evaluate decoupling choices and placement, considering capacitance, parasitics and the interaction between silicon, package and PCB.
* Use electromagnetic simulation to extract and understand resistance, inductance, coupling and impedance in power and ground structures.
* Check model setup, assumptions, convergence and physical validity, and explain the limitations of your results.
* Translate findings into practical recommendations for decoupling, layout, power and ground distribution, and other PI design choices.
* Document results, identify technical risks and contribute to design reviews and PI verification.
* Work with test engineers to define relevant measurements, interpret results and investigate differences between simulation and hardware.
* Collaborate with PI, SI

## **About H:**

When we released Holo4 on 28 September, we published every trajectory behind its public benchmark scores at trajectories.hcompany.ai. For OSWorld that's 369 desktop tasks, each run 3 times, with the steps, tokens and time of every attempt. This role builds and runs the evaluation framework that produces runs like these.

H builds computer-use agents and the models behind them. Developers use them through a managed API, and our forward deployed engineers take them into enterprise workflows.

## What this team owns

The evaluation framework: orchestration, runtimes and observability. Researchers and forward deployed engineers bring the benchmarks, across web apps, desktop applications and the command line. Your job is to make the framework that runs them reliable, fast and cheap, and to make adding a new one quick. Research uses the results to choose checkpoints and decide whether a model ships. Product and the forward deployed engineers use them to measure agents on customer workflows. It carries roughly 50 benchmarks now. That number should be between 100 and 200 soon, and the framework has to keep up.

## What you'd be doing

* Integration support for researchers and forward deployed engineers bringing in a benchmark, with a shorter path each time.
* Setting the standard for how a benchmark enters the framework, and building the checks that enforce it.
* Scheduling and observability, so cluster capacity isn't left idle while evaluation jobs queue.
* Reproducible results across trials, so a release decision rests on numbers that hold.
* Whatever stack a benchmark calls for. One week that's cluster tuning; the next it's a browser extension or desktop environments.
* Time with customers, from single developers to large companies, to find out what they want measured, then automating it so the results flow back into our harnesses and models.

## The first few months

By 3 months you'll have helped researchers or forward deployed engineers integrate 5 benchmarks, and started fixing what slows the framework down. By 6 months one part of it is yours, for example scaling the runs, observability, or a group of related benchmarks, and a release will have gone out on your numbers. By 12 months you'll know the design and trade-offs of the whole evaluation system, and be the person the rest of H asks about evaluations.

## Who you'd work with

Ceiran Chapman, our VP Engineering, is hiring for this role. You'd join the evaluation team. The people relying on your work day to day are H's researchers and forward deployed engineers.

## What we think it takes

**Likely a good fit if you**

* Have spent 5+ years in backend development, with production Python at the core, and use coding agents to go faster without letting quality drop.
* Have built test, QA or evaluation tooling that other teams depended on, and care whether a number is right.
* Have operated distributed systems on Kubernetes in a public cloud. AWS experience helps most.
* Have built and shipped systems end to end, including APIs (REST or GraphQL) and integrations with outside services.
* Know relational and non-relational databases, and message queues such as SQS, RabbitMQ or Kafka.
* Instrument what you build, with metrics, tracing and monitoring from the start.

**Stronger still if you have**

* Measured LLM quality before, or built agents yourself.
* Packaged and run workloads in Docker and on virtual machines.
* Used Temporal, Dask, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Grafana or Datadog.
* Automated web or desktop software with Playwright, Selenium or a browser extension you wrote.
* Set standards other engineers follow, through code review, design review or mentoring.

**You do not need** a background in machine learning. We'll work that out with you. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway.

## How we hire

A 30 minute call with our Talent team, a 60 minute technical challenge, a 60 minute system design interview, and a 30 minute final conversation with Ceiran. About 3.5 hours in total.

## Practicalities

**London posting:** Hybrid in London. That means 3 office days a week and a Paris trip about once every 4 to 6 weeks. There is a Paris posting for the same role. We offer a competitive package.

# Procurement Project Manager – UK

## Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 

## The role

As Procurement Project Manager at Helsing, you will take ownership of procurement activities across development and customer projects, working within established programme structures while bringing increasing independence to how you manage suppliers, timelines, and cost. You will be involved early in project phases, giving you the opportunity to contribute to sourcing decisions before they become fixed constraints. Your work connects engineering, supply chain, production, and external partners, and your ability to coordinate across those boundaries will determine whether projects are set up to deliver. From prototyping through to production ramp-up, you will ensure that the right suppliers are selected, that costs stay on track, and that quality is maintained throughout. At this level, you will be building the experience and judgement needed to manage increasingly complex scopes, supported by senior colleagues while taking genuine responsibility for defined workstreams.

## The day-to-day

* Support and lead procurement activities across development and customer projects, ensuring cost, quality, and schedule targets are met across assigned workstreams
* Engage early in project planning phases to contribute to sourcing strategies, flag potential supply risks, and align procurement timelines with engineering and programme milestones
* Research, evaluate, and recommend suppliers for technical components and systems, applying clear assessment criteria and escalating trade-offs for senior review where appropriate
* Serve as a reliable interface between engineering, procurement, suppliers, and production teams, ensuring technical requirements are clearly communicated and that issues are surfaced promptly
* Support prototyping, industrialisation, and serial production ramp-up phases, adapting procurement approaches as projects move through different stages of development
* Track supplier performance against agreed commitments and flag deviations in cost, quality, or delivery early enough for corrective action to be taken
* Contribute to building and maintaining a qualified supplier base that meets Helsing's technical and compliance requirements

## You should apply if you

* Have managed procurement activities within technically complex or project-driven environments, taking responsibility for defined workstreams from requirements through to delivery
* Can read and interpret technical documentation well enough to engage meaningfully with engineering teams and assess supplier capabilities without constant support
* Have coordinated across cross-functional teams, keeping engineering, production, and supplier stakeholders aligned on priorities and timelines
* Have supported or led supplier negotiations and relationship management for technical components, with an understanding of what good contract terms look like
* Bring a structured and methodical approach to managing competing priorities, with the ability to escalate clearly when trade-offs arise
* Communicate clearly (in both written and spoken English), adjusting your level of detail to suit technical and non-technical audiences

**Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically* *under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.**

## Nice to Have

* Exposure to defence, aerospace, or other regulated industries where compliance, traceability, and quality requirements shape procurement practice

job_description:
Who are we?
Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

Senior Platform Engineer - Azure Data & AI Platform 
The Role 
We are looking for senior platform engineers to build and operate our Azure-based data and AI platform. This is hands-on infrastructure and platform work - you'll be writing Terraform, designing network architecture, implementing MLOps (AI model) pipelines, and establishing DevSecOps patterns that engineering teams can use. 
This isn't a "thought leadership" or "strategy" role. You'll be in the code, in the CLI, and in the infrastructure daily. 
What You'll Actually Do 
Azure Platform Engineering (40%) 
Design and implement Azure landing zones, management groups, and subscription architecture 
Build and maintain hub-spoke network topologies with proper segmentation and security controls 
Implement Azure Policy, RBAC, and governance frameworks that balance security with developer productivity 
Manage identity and access using Entra ID, service principals, managed identities 
Establish monitoring, logging, and alerting with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights 
Cost management and FinOps practices - keeping cloud spend under control without hamstringing teams 
Databricks & Data Platform (30%) 
Deploy and configure Azure Databricks workspaces with Unity Catalog for data governance 
Assisting both data and AI teams with pipeline development 
Establish Databricks best practices: cluster policies, job scheduling, notebook standards, workspace organization 
Integrate Databricks with ADLS Gen2, Azure SQL, Synapse, and other data services 
Set up and maintain CI/CD for Databricks notebooks, jobs, and infrastructure 
Work with data engineers on performance optimization, cost control, and platform capabilities 
MLOps & AI Platform (20%) 
Build ML model deployment pipelines using Azure ML, Databricks MLflow, or both 
Implement model versioning, experiment tracking, and model registry patterns 
Establish inference endpoints (batch and real-time) with proper monitoring and governance 
Create reusable ML pipeline templates and infrastructure-as-code modules 
Integrate AI services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services) into platform offerings 
Implement responsible AI guardrails: model monitoring, bias detection, explainability 
DevSecOps & Platform Enablement (10%) 
Creation of tools, features and dashboards for the developer platform 
Build CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions with proper security scanning 
Implement shift-left security: SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, infrastructure scanning, secrets management 
Establish infrastructure-as-code standards with Terraform (or Bicep), including modules and policy enforcement 
Create self-service tooling and automation for common platform tasks 
Write documentation that engineers will read and use 
Participate in on-call rotation for platform incidents 
What We Need From You 
Required 
5+ years platform/infrastructure engineering - you've built production platforms, not just prototypes 
Deep Azure knowledge - networking, IAM, storage, compute, PaaS services. You know the difference between service endpoints and private endpoints and when to use each 
Databricks experience - you've deployed workspaces, configured Unity Catalog, optimized Spark jobs, managed costs 
Infrastructure as Code - Terraform (preferred) or Bicep. You write modules, understand state management, know how to structure large IaC projects 
CI/CD pipelines - Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. You've built multi-stage pipelines with gates, approvals, and security scanning 
Containerization experience – you know best practices when building and working with both application-based containers and containers holding ML/AI models 
Security-first mindset - you understand defense in depth, least privilege, network segmentation, and don't treat security as an afterthought 
MLOps fundamentals - model training vs inference, experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment patterns 
Python and/or PowerShell - for automation, tooling, and platform utilities 
Observability stack beyond basic metrics (distributed tracing, log aggregation patterns) 
Strongly Preferred 
Experience with Azure landing zones and CAF (Cloud Adoption Framework) 
Microsoft Purview for data governance and cataloging 
Experience with Delta Lake, Spark optimization, data quality frameworks 
Azure networking certifications or equivalent deep knowledge 
Container orchestration (AKS) 
API design and management (API Management, App Gateway, Front Door) 
What Actually Matters 
Pragmatism over purity - you choose the right tool for the job, not the coolest one 
Documentation discipline - you document as you build because you know future-you will thank today-you 
Automation mindset - if you do it twice, you automate it 
Everything-as-code – if it’s not in git, it doesn’t exist to you 
Collaboration skills - you can translate between data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders 
Ownership mentality - you build it, you run it, you support it 
Intellectual honesty - you say "I don't know" when you don't, and then you figure it out 
What We Offer 
Actual flexibility: Remote-first with occasional in-office travel for workshops/planning. We care about outcomes, not seat time. 
Real learning budget: for conferences, training, certifications. We expect you to use it. 
Tooling: You'll get the equipment and licenses you need to do the job properly. 
Grown-up engineering culture: 
PRs are required, branching is mandatory, tests matter 
Blameless post-mortems when things break 
Technical decisions driven by evidence and context, not politics or trends 
We write RFCs for significant changes

Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges

# Senior Manager - Warehouse, Inventory Logistics and Planning

## Location

UK, London

## Employment Type

Full time

On-site

OperationsSupply Chain & Logistics

OverviewApplication

Here at Humanoid, we believe in a future where robots amplify human potential. That’s why we’ve set out on a mission to build the world’s most capable, commercially-scalable, and safe humanoid robots. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‐01 - our rapidly developed humanoid platform being deployed in real industrial environments - and we’re growing the team to take it even further.

# About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager – WILP to build and lead Humanoid’s global Warehouse, Inventory, Logistics and Planning function across London, Boston and Vancouver. This is a hands-on build role in a fast-moving prototype and NPI environment, scaling towards production. The role reports to the Senior Director, Supply Chain Management.

# What You'll Do

**Strategy and leadership**

* Define the WILP strategy and roadmap, aligned with company strategy and the Senior Director, Supply Chain Management.
* Build a lean operating model, governance, KPIs and cadence for warehouse, inventory, logistics and planning that works in a fast-changing NPI environment and scales as volumes grow.
* Lead, coach and develop the WILP team across sites, building capability and hiring as the function grows.
* Support the WILP teams across regional sites.
* Set OKRs, KPIs, and performance expectations.
* Foster a high‐performance, collaborative, curious and continuous‐improvement culture.
* Decisive and data driven, able to make priority calls under pressure.
* Confident communicator with customers and executives, keeps promises and raises risks early.
* This role operates in a high‐complexity robotics supply chain with multi‐tier suppliers, long lead times, export controls and frequent engineering change.
* Ensure compliance with safety, environmental and regulatory standards across all WILP operations.
* Act as deputy for the Senior Director, Supply Chain Management when required.

**Planning and order fulfilment**

* Build a pragmatic planning and scheduling process suited to NPI and prototype builds, evolving towards make to order, assemble to order and configure to order flows as volumes ramp.
* Run daily and weekly tier meetings to manage exceptions, shortages, and expedites, ensuring clear root‐cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Lead the available to promise process, including project slotting and allocations during shortages.
* Ensure export compliance, documentation accuracy and clean handover to carriers and customs partners.
* Be part of exploring and selecting MRP/ERP and planning systems: define requirements and a phased roadmap, while keeping planning effective on lightweight tools in the meantime.
* Work with Demand and Production Planning, Material Planning and Engineering to keep build plans, material availability and change cycles aligned.

**Warehouse and Inventory**

* Develop and maintain inventory management processes to optimise warehouse operations.
* Oversee and execute inventory counts, reconciliation, and audits.
* Monitor and manage stock levels to meet customer demands and avoid overstock or shortages.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve inventory processes and accuracy.
* Maintain a clean, organised, and safe warehouse environment.

**Logistics & Supplier / Customer focus**

* Design a logistics model that supports today’s site-to-site and prototype flows and can scale to central and regional DCs and cross docks.
* Select and manage 3PLs, carriers and freight forwarders with clear SLAs and regular performance reviews.
* Implement transport management and consolidation rules that protect on-time delivery and cost.
* Strong understanding of Incoterms and global trade compliance.
* Good understanding of logistics processes across the Americas, UK, and Europe.
* Ensure warehouse processes, inventory accuracy and cycle counting reach Group standards, using WMS capability as it is introduced.
* Build fulfilment playbooks for customer deployments, including kitting, pre assembly and sequenced deliveries to site.
* Create a proactive milestone tracking and communication model that gives customers crystal clear ETAs and risks.
* Agree service levels by customer segment, including on-time in-full targets, lead time windows and communication rules, as customer volumes build.

# What We're Looking For

* **Experience & Qualifications**

  + 10+ years of direct Warehouse, Inventory, Logistics & Planning experience, ideally in manufacturing, robotics, technology, aero / defence, automotive or FMCG.
  + Demonstrable, hands-on experience across all four WILP areas: warehouse operations, inventory management, logistics and planning. Depth in only one or two is not sufficient; candidates must show a track record of delivering results in each.
  + Proven experience establishing or scaling direct WILP functions, hands-on and comfortable working in the detail.
  + Start-up or scale-up experience, building processes and teams from scratch in a fast-changing environment, is desirable.
  + Degree in Business, International Supply Chain & Procurement Management, Engineering, or related field.
  + CIPS (MCIPS) Level 5 or equivalent; APICS CPIM desirable.
  + Working knowledge of commercial terms and negotiation with logistics providers and carriers.
  + Awareness of export controls (including EAR) relevant to robotics and technology.

  **Technical Skills**

  + Proficient in Google Workspace, Slack, and database management.
  + Hands-on experience with ERP/MRP, WMS and analytics tools such as Power BI. Experience selecting and implementing MRP/ERP systems, and running planning effectively on spreadsheets and lightweight tools while systems mature, is a strong advantage.
  + Proven success serving project based or engineer to order customers.
  + Proven leadership of multi‐site or multi‐region operations and external logistics partners
  + Expert in S&OP, master scheduling, MRP and inventory optimisation.
  + Strong analytical, numerical, and planning capabilities.

  **Behavioural Skills**

  + Excellent negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder‐management skills.
  + Ability to work cross‐functionally in a fast‐paced, engineering‐driven environment.
  + Highly organised, adaptable, and able to manage shifting priorities.
  + Professional, motivated, and able to operate autonomously and within teams.

# What We Offer

* Competitive equity: stock options with meaningful upside as we scale.
* 30+ paid days off, including 23 days of annual leave, all UK bank holidays, and additional company closure days (including Christmas–New Year shutdown).
* Private healthcare, including virtual and in-person care.
* Pension scheme with 8% total contribution (5% employee, 3% employer) on full earnings.
* Free daily breakfast, catered lunch, and snacks in-office.
* Work at the frontier - collaborate daily with world-class engineers, researchers, and product experts building the next generation of AI and humanoid robotics.
* Real ownership - direct access to founding leadership, meaningful input on product direction, and the ability to drive key initiatives from day one.

Yard Operative

**Yard Operative – Huws Gray Nottingham - Keep Things Moving Behind the Scenes**

**Be Part of Something Bigger at Huws Gray.**

Whether you're in the trade or simply love a good home improvement project, chances are you've heard of us. We’re the **Huws Gray Group** – home to a family of trusted brands including Huws Gray, Huws Gray Plant & Tool Hire, Civils & Lintels, The Timber Group, PDM, NDI, and Anglia Tool Centre. Across the UK, our branches support local communities with everything they need for building, improving, and creating – we couldn’t do it without our people and that’s where you come in!

**What you’ll be doing:**

As a Yard Operative, you’ll play a vital role in the day-to-day running of the yard. Here’s what the job involves:

* **Helping customers find what they need** – offering friendly, practical advice and sharing your knowledge of our products

We’re happy to explore flexible working options. Feel free to chat with us about it during the interview. While we might not be able to meet every request, we’ll always listen with an open mind—and there’s no judgment in asking.

---

**What you’ll bring:**

**We’re not expecting you to know it all from day one – that’s what we’re here for.**  
We’ll give you the training and support to help you hit the ground running. What really matters is that you’ve got a **great attitude** and **you’re ready to pitch in and be part of the team**. Got a forklift licence? That’s a bonus – but it’s definitely not a dealbreaker.

---

**What’s in it for you:**

We believe great work should be recognised and rewarded. Here’s what you can expect:

* **A strong annual leave allowance, alongside your bank holidays**
* **Company bonus scheme,** based on performance
* **Contributory pension** and **life assurance**
* **Discounts** onhigh street retailers, supermarkets, restaurants, gyms and cinemas
* **Colleague discount** across our group brands
* Attraction and travel **discounts**
* **Training and development** programmes to support your growth

We offer on-the-job training and opportunities to work towards recognised qualifications, including apprenticeships.

---

At Huws Gray, we believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce makes us stronger, smarter and better at serving our customers.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful and inclusive workplace, whether you’re based in one of our branches, on the road or in one of our offices.

If you need any adjustments to support you through the application or interview process, please let us know.

## **About this role**

Our website is one of the most important ways people discover what we offer, understand our value, and decide whether to talk to Sales or start a trial. The Web Growth team owns its roadmap and continuously improves the journey from first impression through to lead capture, demo engagement, signup, and trial start.

You’ll treat the website like a product: understand user intent, find confusion and friction, form strong hypotheses, test them with users and data, and turn what you learn into better experiences.

You’ll be just as comfortable shaping the problem and influencing the roadmap as you are designing the final interaction, prototype, or page.

## **What you’ll be doing**

* **Experimentation:** Designing and iterating on experiments across landing pages, pricing, signup, and conversion flows to improve engagement, conversion, qualified leads, and trial starts.

* **Product design:** Applying product design thinking to comprehension, navigation, forms, interactive demos, responsiveness, and accessibility.
* **Prototyping and systems:** Prototyping in Figma and code, using AI tools where useful, and working within shared components and brand systems.
* **Roadmap ownership:** Bringing ideas to the Web Growth roadmap, not just executing briefs.

## **Must have experience**

* **Experience:** 5+ years in web, product, growth, or a closely related design role, with a strong portfolio of shipped, conversion-focused work.
* **Growth mindset:** A track record of using design, growth frameworks, conversion rate optimisation, and funnel analysis to improve outcomes such as leads, conversion, trials, activation, or revenue.
* **Experimentation:** Experience designing and iterating on experiments, including A/B tests or other data-informed approaches. B2B SaaS experience is a plus.
* **Craft and taste:** Excellent visual and interaction design skills, with a sharp eye for typography, hierarchy, detail, and polish.
* **Systems and brand:** Comfortable working within an existing design system and brand, while identifying opportunities to extend and improve it.
* **AI fluency:** Experience using AI in your design practice, including tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Figma Make, or similar. You should be able to explain how AI has changed your workflow and what you have built or shipped with it.
* **Ownership:** Able to take a brief and run with it. You work independently, make good decisions, ask the right questions, and bring solutions rather than just options.

## **Who this role is not for**

This role is not for you if:

* You only want to design campaign or marketing pages from a fixed brief. This role owns the journey from first visit through to lead, demo, signup, or trial.
* You care about visual polish but not about comprehension, navigation, forms, interactive demos, or reducing friction.
* You don’t want to work with funnel data, user research, experimentation, or the realities of implementation.
* You want to focus on brand expression without balancing it with usability, accessibility, performance, and measurable growth.
* You need a fixed roadmap and detailed requirements rather than identifying opportunities and shaping what the team should test next.
* You’re not interested in working closely with Growth, Marketing, Product, Data, Research, and Engineering to make the website perform better.

## **What success looks like**

You’ll know you’re successful if:

* More visitors understand Fin and Intercom, find the right path for their needs, and take the next step with less friction.
* You’ve improved meaningful growth outcomes across qualified leads, demo engagement, signups, and trial starts.
* Experiments are well designed, clearly measured, and used to inform what the team does next.
* You’ve made complex product value easier to understand and act on without relying on extra explanation from Sales or Marketing.
* You’ve built strong working relationships with Growth, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Sales, and Customer Success.
* You’ve raised the bar for web growth design through thoughtful, high-quality experiences that people trust and want to use.

We understand that interviewing for a new role is both time- and energy-consuming. We aim to be thorough, speedy, and transparent in our approach.

You should expect the entire process to take no more than four weeks from start to finish. You’ll meet with members of our team and have the opportunity to validate that Intercom and the role are the right fit for you.

Investa is building the UK’s first zero-commission Options and Stocks trading platform. Legacy platforms typically feature high fees and complex interfaces that cut out the majority of retail investors. We are building a streamlined alternative to fix that.

So far, we have raised £3.5 million in funding, secured direct regulatory approval from the FCA, and picked up two major awards in 2026: Best Options Trading App (Good Money Guide) and Best App for Options Trading (ADVFN). Having launched on iOS - reaching 4,000+ total sign-ups - we have now just launched on Android, doubling our addressable market as we scale toward targets of 10,000 users, 100,000, and beyond.

Key Platform Traction:

* 8,000+ trades processed
* 2,500+ early supporters rewarded for their loyalty
* 1,000+ shareholders backing our vision
* 150+ 5-star reviews

Our goal is straightforward: Think Options, Think Investa.

We are a lean, agile team where every employee directly shapes the business. We don't have a corporate way of working. Instead, we look for people who want high autonomy, care about making a visible impact, and align with our core values of being Collaborative, Curious, and Creative.

## **The Role**

As our Risk & Controls Operations Associate, you will serve as the first line of regulatory and operational control for Investa’s platform. Working together with our Head of Risk & Compliance and Co-Founders, you will help own the day-to-day execution of our key operational controls spanning CASS oversight, onboarding operations, financial crime monitoring, and execution control.

This is a critical, high-visibility role within a fast-scaling financial trading environment. You will bridge regulatory oversight with practical execution: verifying client money flows, resolving dealing and onboarding exceptions, and ensuring our operations adhere strictly to FCA standards as our operating model expands from sub-account clearing into in-house custody.

## **What the role involves**

### **1. Risk & Control Operations**

* CASS Reconciliations: Perform daily internal & external CASS reconciliations across Investa’s client base to prevent breaches and ensure compliance with day-to-day CASS obligations.
* CASS Reporting & Audits: Maintain audit-ready compliance records, log breaks and CASS breaches, and assist in preparing regulatory returns and notifications when needed.
* KYC & Onboarding Operations: Own the day-to-day onboarding queue, performing KYC/AML document reviews, appropriateness assessments, and managing PEPs, sanctions, and high-risk escalations.
* Financial Crime Monitoring: Organise high-risk client reviews assisting with enhanced due diligence, source of funds/wealth checks, and periodic and event driven reviews.
* Vulnerable Customer Framework: Manage sensitive customer cases as identified in the vulnerable clients policy, ensure good outcomes for clients with support needs, manage key performance indicators for clients in this segment in strict compliance with Consumer Duty standards and internal policies.

### **2. Business Oversight & Governance Support**

* Management Information: Own and gather key performance indicators covering all aspects of the business for committee reporting and oversight.
* Financial Promotions: Review and approve marketing campaigns, product copy, and social media promotions to ensure strict alignment with FCA Financial Promotion and Consumer Duty rules.
* Regulatory Change: Assist in implementation of regulatory change in the UK or elsewhere to ensure compliance with new rules that apply to the Firm.
* Third Party Risk Management: Point of contact for vendors and outsourcing partners to oversee and coordinate information sharing for incident closure & customer support.
* Trade surveillance: Provide first line review of alerts generated through trade surveillance for signs of market abuse. Oversee the closure of alerts and applicable audit trail.

## **Your Background**

* 2+ years of hands-on experience covering trade operations or controls support at a regulated firm, FinTech, investment platform, or broker.
* Understanding of the regulatory framework surrounding CASS, Consumer Duty, Systems & Controls, and Anti-Money Laundering.
* Direct experience executing CASS reconciliation workflows, client adoption, and trade surveillance.
* Strong analytical mindset with high attention to detail and sound, practical judgement.
* Technical proficiency in Office and Google-based software including excel, Google Sheets, Google Docs.

## **Desirable**

* Prior exposure to retail investment platforms, derivatives markets.
* Experience using workflow tools like Jira or case management software.
* Familiarity with third-party clearing integrations (e.g., Interactive Brokers) or regulatory reporting tools.
* CISI or equivalent qualification regarding financial services, client assets, or regulatory modules.
* Understanding of EU regulation.

* Career Ownership & Impact: You have autonomy over your execution and your career trajectory. Your work impacts the business immediately without corporate red tape. You can choose whether you want to pave a path as a high-level individual contributor or step into management as we scale - you shape your career.
* Collaboration & Proximity: You work alongside our co-founders. Because of our size, our culture is extremely personal. Everyone has firsthand insight into top-level strategy, cross-departmental exposure, and a voice in the product journey.
* Creativity & Speed: We prioritise innovation through speed, agility, thinking outside the box, and resource-efficient solutions.

## About this role

You're the one people trust with the words, whether you're writing them or fixing them. You noticed that **you loved it, and that you were unusually good at it**. You turn rough, complex ideas into words people understand.

Now you get the opportunity to work with some of the most respected designers alive, and help share their knowledge with hundreds of thousands of learners around the world.

A great hook pulls your readers in, makes them see themselves in the topic, and shows them why it matters in their lives. That's your craft. Abstract ideas don't stay abstract for long, because you find the example that makes an idea concrete. You're structured and systematic, yet creative, and you'll rewrite a sentence six times until it says exactly what you mean.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

If you're also curious about how great design and the responsible use of AI improve people's lives, read on. As one of our Course Writers and Editors, you'll shape how our courses and Master Classes read and flow.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes include **[REDACTED] and [REDACTED]**, as well as Design Leads at **[REDACTED], [REDACTED], [REDACTED], and [REDACTED]**.

You’ll be involved in all stages of course and Master Class creation, including key decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you to **take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow**. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. You’ll be in a team with minimal distance between word and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

## Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

[REDACTED] is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like [REDACTED], [REDACTED], and [REDACTED], who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us **take online education to new heights** and **make a meaningful impact on humankind**.

At [REDACTED], we’re not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

## We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

* **Our Course Writers and Editors:** lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the user’s perspective. **This is the role described here.**
* **Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI:** lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.
* **Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI:** lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.

We’re a flexible team, and you’ll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

**You, the Course Writer and Editor**, own how our courses and Master Classes read: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish. Our **Education Designers** hand you the structure and the exercises, and they'll often hand you draft headings and hooks along with them. The final wording is yours. You'll work closely with our **Co-Founder, your Team Lead, the Education Designers, and the Course Directors**, and you'll have a real say in what we make. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

## Your Role at [REDACTED]

* **Be a core part of our Editorial Team.** You'll collaborate with [REDACTED] editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to **create educational content for people worldwide**. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with skills in **timeless, human-centered design and AI**.
* **Make an impact as you decide how every course sounds.** The title people want to click, the first paragraph that hooks them, the on-screen words that make our learners remember and apply what our experts teach. Our Education Designers create the structure and draft the headings, hooks, and quizzes. You finalize the scripts, hooks, headings, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish, and you give proactive feedback on the structure.
* **You don't need a design background.** Most of our writers and editors start without one, and that can be an advantage because you're coming to design the way many of our learners do. In your first year you'll learn it from the inside, working through it sentence by sentence with the people who teach it, until you know what a course participant needs.
* **Write for a diverse, global audience.** Some of our courses and Master Classes serve experienced designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields, and many are not reading in their first language. Often, you'll write for all of them at the same time. Getting that balance right without watering anything down is a rewarding editorial challenge.
* **Be the voice of [REDACTED].** Our reputation lives in every sentence we publish, and many of those sentences will be yours. **Represent a global movement dedicated to design education**, and take pride in it. It's a big responsibility, and a rewarding one.
* **Set and raise the standard for our assessments**, so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests. Our Education Designers decide what a question has to test. You write the wording that does both.
* **Balance the big picture with the smaller details.** Expect to focus on one large course creation project per month, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published. You'll also write and edit articles, course descriptions, and supporting material, and help our Growth team and our two founders get the voice right in campaigns and social copy.
* **Turn expert material into lessons.** Once you've built an understanding of design, you'll take a one-hour Master Class transcript and the learning goals for what the lesson must teach, then turn the strongest sections into a finished lesson. We produce 3 Master Classes per month, so new expert material arrives continuously.
* Our courses **combine written and video lessons.** You'll work closely with the video team, giving **constructive feedback** on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from.
