The day

## What the work actually is.

Imaging first, always: the original drive is evidence, the copy is the workbench. Your day moves between logical recoveries, failing mechanical drives that get one good read if they get any, and the conversations that come with them, because the person on the phone is not asking about a drive, they are asking about their photographs.

Some days end with everything back. Some end with you explaining, carefully, what is gone. Both have to be done well, and the second one is the reason this role needs a particular kind of person.

Deep familiarity with filesystems, storage hardware and imaging tools, and the discipline to work on copies without exception. You can explain risk in plain English before work starts, you never promise what the hardware has not agreed to, and you treat a stranger's files with the privacy you would want for your own.

**In one line:** Methodical before anything else, fluent in filesystems and failure modes, and comfortable refusing risky work.

# B2B Sales & Marketing Coordinator

We usually respond within three days

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We’re looking for an organised, commercially minded and proactive B2B Sales & Marketing Coordinator to join our Wholesale team, supporting the continued growth of our B2B business across our four global brands: Joma Jewellery, A Littles & Co, Katie Loxton and Katie Loxton Inc.

Working closely with our B2B Sales & Marketing Manager and wider commercial team, you’ll play a key role in coordinating day-to-day B2B marketing activity, supporting sales operations and helping us maximise opportunities across our wholesale channels.

You will make an impact by coordinating B2B sales and marketing activity across our global brands and territories, supporting new season launches, campaigns and promotions, and ensuring our sales channels and customer-facing platforms remain accurate and up to date. You’ll also support our Sales Agent network with day-to-day queries, reporting, prospecting and sales administration, helping to identify and maximise opportunities for commercial growth.

Acting as a central point of communication across Sales, Marketing, Creative, Customer Experience, Operations and Events, you’ll help ensure activity is aligned and delivered smoothly. This is a great opportunity for someone with experience in sales, marketing or commercial coordination who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is looking to develop their career within a growing global fashion and lifestyle business.

The role is Monday - Friday 9am-5pm. You'll enjoy the exciting buzz of our friendly office in Banbury, Oxfordshire three times a week on average with the flexibility to work from home for the remaining two days. This may increase to 5 days a week during peak periods.

**BEHIND THE BRANDS**

We’re a family-run, entrepreneurial company with an exciting pace of life and a bright and friendly team. We are passionate about creating stunning products with a personal touch and innovating our business behind the scenes. We value creativity, collaboration and integrity. 

**HOW YOU'LL CONTRIBUTE**

* Supporting the B2B Sales & Marketing Manager and wider Wholesale team to drive commercial growth, strengthen Sales Agent performance and maximise opportunities to achieve and exceed agreed sales targets.
* Coordinating and executing the B2B marketing calendar across all territories, ensuring activity is aligned with the wider wholesale strategy and commercial objectives.
* Supporting the delivery of new season launches, coordinating sales tools including brochures, training materials, creative assets, emails, app content and website updates.
* Coordinating B2B email marketing campaigns, ensuring content is accurate, engaging and delivered on schedule.
* Monitoring and maintaining the B2B sales app, ensuring product categories, collections, pricing, imagery and stock availability are accurate and up to date.
* Maintaining and regularly auditing B2B websites, ensuring product listings, seasonal campaigns and category pages are accurate and complete.
* Partnering with the Customer Experience team to support Sales Agents with day-to-day queries and ensure prompt resolution.
* Assisting with reporting and analysing sales performance, campaign results, customer engagement and website activity to identify opportunities for improvement and growth.
* Identifying new wholesale marketing opportunities and initiatives to support sales growth, including reviewing new stockist enquiries before sharing with Sales Agents.
* Monitoring competitor activity, industry trends and customer feedback, sharing relevant insights and opportunities with the wider team.
* Ensuring sales and marketing information remains accurate and consistent across internal systems and customer-facing platforms, applying appropriate regional spelling, terminology and product information.
* Coordinating trade press advertising briefs, including supporting additional editorial opportunities and features.
* Supporting the Wholesale and Events teams with sales and marketing requirements for owned stores and external stockists, including imagery, assets, showroom presentations, events and invitations.
* Building strong working relationships across Sales, Marketing, Creative, Operations, Customer Experience and the Sales Agent network to support effective communication and delivery of commercial objectives.
* Providing sales administration support across the UK and EU Sales Agent network, including sales performance and gaps reporting, prospecting support, new stockist enquiries and showroom coordination.
* Undertaking additional projects and responsibilities to support the continued growth of the wholesale channel.

 

**THE TALENT YOU'LL BRING**

* Previous experience within a B2B Sales, Marketing or Commercial Coordinator/Assistant role.
* A strong understanding of sales processes and marketing principles, with good commercial awareness.
* Experience maintaining product information and data, ideally across customer-facing sales or ecommerce platforms.
* Exceptional accuracy and attention to detail, particularly when working with product information, pricing and written content.
* Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work collaboratively across multiple teams and external partners.
* A proactive and solutions-focused approach, with the confidence to take ownership and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel; experience with CRM, ERP or sales management systems would be advantageous.
* Experience within the fashion, lifestyle or jewellery industry would be desirable but isn't essential.
* A highly motivated, collaborative and positive can-do attitude, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

**PERFECTLY PACKAGED**

* A salary of up to £32,000
* 33 days holiday including bank holidays rising to 35 with length of service
* A broad benefits package including our staff favourite – a very generous staff discount across both our brands. See all of our benefits on our careers portal
* Opportunities to make an impact as well as learn and develop further
* An innovative and friendly workplace with a team we’re proud to be part of. Find out more about us and our culture on our careers portal

At KBR, We Deliver.

This role serves as the primary liaison between Talent Acquisition, candidates, hiring managers, People Team, People Operations, Global Mobility, and the Global Vetting Team to manage pre-employment requirements, onboarding workflows, background screening, drug testing, compliance documentation, and onboarding communications.

  

In addition to supporting onboarding activities within an assigned region, the Global Onboarding Lead provides functional leadership and oversight to Regional Onboarding Coordinators globally. The role is responsible for establishing standards, driving process consistency, monitoring service delivery, managing onboarding metrics, ensuring compliance, and continuously enhancing the candidate experience across all regions.

  

The Global Onboarding Lead plays a critical role in delivering a world-class onboarding experience while ensuring onboarding and compliance requirements are completed accurately, timely, and in accordance with company policies and local regulations. This role also supports recruiters through ATS administration, operational reporting, process governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Additional Leadership Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day leadership, guidance, and functional oversight for all Regional Onboarding Coordinators.
* Establish global onboarding standards, procedures, service levels, and process documentation.
* Ensure consistency in onboarding practices, communications, compliance requirements, and candidate experience across all regions.
* Review onboarding metrics and operational performance to identify trends, risks, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.
* Mentor, train, and onboard Regional Onboarding Coordinators.
* Facilitate regular team meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice discussions.
* Act as the escalation point for complex onboarding, compliance, vetting, and candidate issues.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition leadership, and People Operations and Technology teams on onboarding enhancements and system improvements.
* Lead global onboarding projects, process transformations, and ATS optimization initiatives.

**Qualifications, Skills and Experience**

**Required**

Qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent experience.

* Relevant experience in onboarding, recruiting operations, talent acquisition operations, HR operations, or related functions.
* Experience leading projects, processes, or coordinating work across multiple regions.
* Experience managing background screening, employment verification, drug testing, right-to-work verification, and onboarding programs.
* Experience with ATS and HR technology platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management, leadership, and change management skills.
* Experience supporting regional or global onboarding processes.

**The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership**

With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.

At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.

**About the Role**

The Change Management Administrator & Change Management Analyst is responsible for the administration, coordination, analysis, and continuous improvement of the organisation's change management processes. The role ensures that changes affecting products, processes, documentation, systems, and operational activities are appropriately assessed, approved, implemented, communicated, and recorded.

The position acts as a central point of coordination for change activities, providing governance, reporting, process analysis, and stakeholder support to ensure changes are effectively managed while maintaining compliance, product integrity, and operational efficiency.

## Key Responsibilities

### Change Management Administration

* Administer and coordinate change requests throughout their lifecycle.
* Ensure all changes are reviewed, approved, documented, and implemented in accordance with company procedures.
* Maintain accurate and auditable records of all change activities.
* Monitor change progress and ensure actions are completed within agreed timescales.
* Facilitate change review meetings and support change approval boards.
* Ensure full traceability of decisions, actions, approvals, and implementation activities.
* Support the communication and coordination of approved changes across affected departments.

### Change Management Analysis

* Analyse change management data to identify trends, risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to change effectiveness and process efficiency.
* Conduct root cause analysis on delayed, failed, or recurring changes.
* Develop reports, dashboards, and management summaries.
* Provide recommendations to improve change processes, governance, and business performance.
* Support decision-making through data-driven insights and analysis.

### Process Improvement

* Review existing change management processes and identify improvement opportunities.
* Support the implementation of process improvements and workflow enhancements.
* Assist in developing and maintaining change management procedures, policies, and work instructions.
* Promote standardisation and best practices across the organisation.
* Participate in continuous improvement and business transformation initiatives.
* Support automation and digitalisation projects relating to change control processes.

### Governance & Compliance

* Ensure compliance with organisational policies, quality systems, and regulatory requirements.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Monitor adherence to change management procedures.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of governance frameworks and controls.
* Identify process risks and recommend mitigation actions.
* Ensure document and record retention requirements are met.

### Stakeholder Management

* Serve as a key point of contact for change-related activities.
* Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and other business functions.
* Facilitate collaboration and communication between stakeholders.
* Provide guidance and support on change management requirements and processes.
* Escalate issues and risks appropriately.

### Reporting & Metrics

* Develop and maintain change management performance reports.
* Monitor:
  + Change cycle times
  + Approval lead times
  + Open and overdue actions
  + Implementation effectiveness
  + Compliance metrics
* Present findings and recommendations to management.
* Support strategic planning through trend analysis and performance monitoring.

### Training & Support

* Develop training materials, guidance documents, and user instructions.
* Provide training and coaching on change management processes and best practices.
* Support employees and stakeholders in understanding their responsibilities within the change process.
* Promote awareness and adoption of change management principles throughout the organisation.

## Qualifications & Experience

### Essential

* Experience in change management, engineering administration, business analysis, project coordination, or process improvement.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience managing controlled processes and business records.
* Excellent organisational and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication abilities.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.

### Desirable

* Experience within engineering, manufacturing, quality, operations, or regulated environments.
* Knowledge of product lifecycle, configuration management, or document control processes.
* Experience with workflow management or business process systems.
* Experience using reporting and business intelligence tools such as Power BI.
* Understanding of quality management standards such as ISO 9001

**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**

Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

Founded in 2012, LADbible Group is redefining entertainment and news for a social generation. The Deputy Brand Editor will work closely with the Brand Editor across both editorial and social to help shape and deliver LADbible’s daily content agenda.

Sitting at the heart of the LADbible newsroom, they will manage the day-to-day publishing of content and set content priorities across breaking news, original journalism, search and culturally relevant stories alongside the brand editor.

The Deputy Brand Editor will take a hands-on role in commissioning, editing and publishing content, ensuring it meets LADbible’s standards for accuracy, quality, tone and legal compliance. They will use performance data, audience insights and platform trends to inform editorial decisions.

They will also deputise for the Brand Editor when required.

**Key responsibilities**

* Work closely with the Brand Editor across editorial and social to agree daily priorities, coordinate coverage and ensure a consistent brand voice across platforms.
* Deputise for the Brand Editor when required, providing editorial leadership and making confident publishing decisions.
* Commission, edit and publish news content, including breaking news, trending stories, original journalism and search-led articles.
* Work closely with the audience team to identify opportunities to inform commissioning and forward planning.
* Head up planning and tracking of original journalism and exclusive stories
* Maintain high standards of editorial judgement, storytelling, accuracy, sourcing and media-law compliance.
* Identify potential legal, regulatory and reputational risks before publication, escalating sensitive or complex matters to the Head of Editorial when appropriate.
* Use audience insights, search trends and platform behaviour to inform daily publishing decisions and longer-term content planning.
* Monitor performance through tools including Aperture, Chartbeat, Google Analytics and Mission Control, using findings to optimise coverage.
* Work with the Brand Editor to deliver monthly targets for overall sessions, search traffic and revenue, as set by the Head of Editorial.
* Agree individual reporter KPIs with the Head of Editorial and hold regular performance and development meetings.
* Champion LADbible’s editorial voice, tone and standards across all output.
* Ensure content is culturally relevant, distinctive and aligned with audience interests.
* Manage and participate in the team rota, ensuring appropriate staffing for evenings, weekends, major events and periods of increased news activity.

**Required skills and experience**

* Significant experience in digital publishing, preferably within a fast-paced newsroom and in an editorial leadership role.
* Proven experience managing, motivating and developing a team of journalists.
* Strong commissioning and news-editing experience, with the ability to improve copy, headlines, structure and story framing.
* A strong working knowledge of media law, editorial compliance and the legal risks associated with digital publishing.
* Confidence handling legally sensitive stories and knowing when further legal or senior editorial guidance is required.
* Experience using performance data to inform commissioning, publishing and content-planning decisions.
* Experience setting objectives, managing performance and providing actionable feedback.
* Strong communication, organisation and team-coordination skills.
* The ability to adapt quickly to changing workflows, developing stories and fast-moving priorities.
* Experience fostering a collaborative, inclusive and creative newsroom culture.

At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 4 days per week.

    Life Services Group exists to help every family in Britain navigate the hardest moments of life. We bring together trusted names across funeral services, crematoria and cemeteries, legal services, direct cremation and wills, including Dignity Funeral Directors, CMG, Simplicity Cremations, Dignity Legal Services and Farewill, so families can get more of the support they need in one place.

We are looking for a Senior Database Platform Engineer to own the reliability, performance, security and evolution of our database platforms.

This is not a traditional ticket-driven DBA role. While you'll be responsible for keeping our SQL Server and Azure SQL estate healthy, secure and performant, you'll also help modernise our data platforms and support our transition towards PostgreSQL, cloud-native database services and modern lakehouse architectures.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll be troubleshooting performance issues, validating recovery strategies, automating operational processes, improving observability and helping shape the future of our database estate.

You will act as the team's database SME, working closely with Platform Engineers, Data Engineers and Operations teams to ensure critical data services remain resilient, scalable and fit for future needs.

* Own the operational health, availability and performance of SQL Server and Azure SQL platforms

* Provision, configure and maintain production and non-production database environments

* Plan and execute upgrades, patching and platform lifecycle activities

* Diagnose and resolve database performance issues across infrastructure, workloads and application interactions

* Establish and maintain database operational standards and engineering practices

* Manage platform capacity, utilisation and performance forecasting

* Ensure critical database platforms remain secure, resilient and operationally supportable

* Drive continual improvement through automation, root cause analysis and operational learning

* Reduce operational toil through self-healing and automation where practical

**Database Modernisation (15%)**

* Support the evolution of the database estate towards PostgreSQL and modern cloud-native database services

* Define and improve database deployment, configuration and operational standards

* Contribute to migration and modernisation initiatives across legacy database platforms

* Help reduce technical debt through platform simplification and standardisation

* Evaluate new database technologies and operating models where they create business value

**Data Platform Integration (10%)**

* Support integration between database platforms, Databricks and analytics services

* Work alongside Data Engineers to optimise data movement and workload performance

* Contribute database expertise to modern data platform initiatives

**Security, Governance & Compliance (10%)**

* Implement and maintain role-based access controls and database security standards

* Support audit, compliance and governance activities

* Ensure database services align with organisational security and operational policies

At MJ Quinn, we currently have an exciting opportunity for an experienced HSQE Manager to join our growing business.

This role is a hybrid of office and field-based work, requiring regular travel across **the North of the UK**. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining and improving our Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental standards, with a particular focus on Service Delivery operations within the region

**About the role:**

Led by the Head of Health and Safety, the department’s role is to help the business make the best choices for the safety, environment, health and quality of our operation, our team and our customers. We provide technical guidance, advice and assurance on managing HSQE across the business nationally. The role will be to assist and facilitate in the developing, implementing, and maintaining health and safety policies and procedures across all construction projects. This role ensures compliance with legal requirements, industry standards, and company policies to create a safe working environment for employees, subcontractors, and visitors.

**The Key Responsibilities of this Role include but are not limited to the following tasks:**

* To work safely and responsibly within MJ Quinn’s values and operational policies, procedures, and accepted behaviours to avoid harm to yourself, those around you and our neighbours and communities.
* Raising and following up on non-conformance reports, to ensure that any actions identified, pursued, and resolved.
* Work as part of a larger team to develop working practices and procedures.
* Support project management teams on CDM sites.
* Through confident and well-considered counsel, help business operational leaders make compliant HSQE decisions that meet customers’ needs.
* Carry out regular site inspections to check policies and procedures are being implemented.
* Keep up to date with new legislation and maintain a working knowledge of all Health and Safety Executive (HSE) legislation and any developments that affect the employers’ industry.
* Keep records of inspection findings and produce reports that suggest improvements.
* Lead and drive Integrated Management System (Safety, Environment and Quality) compliance, making recommendations for improvements as required, at our work sites and locations.
* The ability to effectively communicate to both internal and external stakeholders at all levels using proactive and reactive data in a clear and concise manner.

**Requirements:**

· Previous health and safety experience within large CDM projects.

* Previous experience in a HSQE Manager role or extensive experience as a HSQE Advisor and are looking to progress.
* NEBOSH General Certificate
* NEBOSH Diploma in Occupational Safety (Or working towards)
* Passionate about Health, Safety, Environment & Quality
* Member of IOSH and achieved or is working towards chartered status.
* Experience of identifying, conducting, communicating, and reviewing various risk assessment types.
* Preference given to candidates holding or willing to gain an ISO 9001/14001/45001 lead auditor qualification
* An effective communicator at all levels with client-facing experience.

**Who are MJ Quinn**

MJ Quinn are an established national organisation, with contracts covering the length and breadth of the UK and Ireland. # Senior Product Designer - Design System

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

**About the role:**

As a Senior Product Designer, you will be responsible for executing high-quality designs for our financial products, ensuring they are intuitive, accessible, and effective. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor junior designers, and champion user-centred design within the organisation. This role requires a strategic mindset, deep UX/UI expertise, and the ability to translate complex financial concepts into seamless user experiences.

**What you’ll do**

* Define and execute design strategies that align with business objectives and user needs.
* Lead the end-to-end design process, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and final UI execution.
* Conduct advanced user research, usability testing, and A/B experiments to validate and refine design solutions.
* Partner closely with product managers and engineers to ensure seamless implementation of designs.
* Design scalable UI components and contribute to our evolving design system.
* Advocate for accessibility (A11y) and inclusive design principles, ensuring our products serve a diverse user base.
* Create and refine micro-interactions and motion elements to improve user engagement and usability.
* Use data-driven insights to continuously improve the user experience and optimise for business impact.
* Mentor and guide junior designers, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.
* Stay ahead of fintech trends and best practices to drive product innovation.

**What you need to succeed**

* 3+ years in a senior product design role, with a strong focus on UX and a demonstrated ability to lead impactful projects
* Mastery of visual design, typography, grids, layout, and colour theory.
* Expertise in interaction design, information architecture, and user flows.
* Deep understanding of designing for both mobile and web platforms, ensuring responsive and adaptive experiences.
* Strong knowledge of behavioural psychology and how it influences user decision-making.
* Extensive experience conducting usability testing, user interviews, and heuristic evaluations.
* Ability to synthesise qualitative and quantitative insights into impactful design decisions.
* Familiarity with UX analytics tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Hotjar, etc.).
* Proficiency in atomic design principles and building scalable UI frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of motion design tools (Lottie, After Effects, Principle) to create dynamic user experiences.
* Experience mentoring and guiding junior designers.
* Ability to articulate design rationale and influence stakeholders across teams.
* Comfortable working in agile, fast-paced product teams.
* Figma mastery - deep experience with auto layout, design tokens, component variants, interactive prototypes, and scalable design libraries.
* Proven experience in fintech and/or SaaS environments, with a strong understanding of industry challenges and user behaviours.

* A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will impact millions of users.
* Career growth opportunities.
* A culture of experimentation - we encourage innovative thinking and rapid iteration.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources.

Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your best work - preferably with fintech or SaaS-related projects. # Director of Group Operations Strategy & Development

Cardiff, London or Remote (UK); London

***🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.***

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

---

📍London / Remote | 💰£112,200 - £146,850 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

**⭐️ Our team**

Our North Star in Operations is to deliver seamless support that builds trust, deepens loyalty, and powers Monzo’s sustainable, profitable growth.

Sitting at the very heart of Monzo Global Operations, you will work within our Group COO team, partnering closely with the Global Operations Leadership team and key Monzo stakeholders to tackle our biggest strategic priorities in pursuit of our challenging goals. You will bridge the gap between bold ambition and rigorous operational execution - turning complex challenges and priorities into clear, measurable actions to progress across UK Operations, EU Operations and Controls. In this role you will build strong relationships with leadership across Customer Operations, EU Operations, Controls, Finance, Tech disciplines and the wider Monzo team, working collaboratively to help build and deliver on our Group COO strategy and operating model.

#### **🔑 You’ll play a key role by...**

**Setting the GCOO Strategy**

* **Shape and own the big picture:** You’ll define, align, and maintain a clear strategy for the Group COO team. Making sure it covers everything across UK Ops, EU Ops, and Controls, so everyone knows where we’re heading and why.

**Goal Setting & Alignment**

* **Align our goals:** you’ll lead the goal-setting process for the GCOO area. Making sure our top-level objectives fit seamlessly with the goals of each sub-function, keeping all our teams rowing in the same direction.

**Financial Control & Insight**

* **Keep us on budget with clear insights:** You’ll partner closely with Finance to build and embed a simple, dependable monthly reporting process. Bringing real rigour and clear forecasting to the numbers so we always understand our financial health.

**Global Operating Model**

* **Design for a global Monzo:** you’ll lead the shift as GCOO transitions into a fully functioning global operating model - building everything with a "global by design" mindset from day one. You’ll help architect how we scale by balancing global efficiency with local market operational requirements, always ensuring we think “global first”.

**Strategic Project Delivery**

* **Deliver key projects:** You’ll take full accountability for a range of high-impact short and medium-term strategic projects, collaborating with teams across all of Monzo to get them over the line.

**Tracking & Governance**

* **Keep everyone informed:** You’ll track our progress against the GCOO strategy and make sure key updates are clearly communicated - whether that’s for CEO reporting, the PRA 90-Day Plan, or our own GCOO Leadership Team.

#### **🤩 We’d love to hear from you if...**

* You have extensive experience operating at a senior strategic level (ideally within fintech, or complex operational environments). You have a track record of shaping business strategy through structured problem-solving, data, and deep business insight.
* You are a proven executor, able to turn strategy into executable projects, ensuring those projects deliver to time and quality.  You switch between the strategic and practical with ease, analysing issues strategically but also being able to ‘do the detail’ to ensure successful execution
* You excel in highly matrixed environments where ownership is shared. You know how to build alignment, resolve trade-offs, and hold cross-functional teams accountable without needing direct reporting lines.
* You speak the language of Operations, Finance, Technology and Controls. You can comfortably translate complex operational or technical signals into clear executive narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* You thrive in unstructured environments where no playbook exists. You enjoy establishing governance, clear communication strategies and moving fluidly between strategic vision and hands-on operational delivery.
* You bring financial discipline and analytical capability, with hands-on experience partnering with Finance to connect operational levers directly to commercial performance.
* You have experience and strong aptitude for navigating complex global versus local operational structures and managing trade-offs across multiple markets
* You have superb communication skills with a proven ability to distill complex ideas and metrics into actionable insights through effective story-telling, high-impact board decks, and clear leadership updates.

**🙌 What’s in it for you**

💰 £112,200 - £146,850 + Incentive awards +  Benefits ✨

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. ➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we'll always work around your availability. You'll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process, but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact ninaebanksmetcalfe@monzo.com

* **Recruiter Call - 30 mins**

Good luck **🍀**

* Respond to client queries and maintain clear, professional communication with businesses.
* Build strong working relationships with an assigned portfolio of clients.
* Use Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook and internal systems extensively.
* Maintain accurate digital records within a fully paperless filing environment.
* Ensure client documents are correctly indexed, organised and stored.

* Intermediate to advanced Excel skills, including confidence using formulas such as **VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP**, IF formulas and **Pivot Tables**.
* Strong numerical ability and confidence working with data.

* A great selection of additional benefits through our salary sacrifice scheme

If you’re inspired by fairer finances, passionate about making a meaningful impact, and truly care about our customers, you’re one of us.

At Nationwide, you are challenged to grow and rewarded for doing so. Valued. Recognised. Inspired to be your best. As a community we want our working lives to count. As a team, we celebrate what we achieve. As a standard-setter, we work for the good of customers, communities, and broader society.

London; Norway

|  |
| --- |
| **About Nscale** |

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

|  |
| --- |
| **About the Role (Job Purpose)** |

Commissioning is the last gate between capital spent and capacity earning. On contracted AI campuses it is a contractual event with dates, evidence requirements and remedies attached — not an internal quality exercise.

As a Director of Commissioning you own that gate. You will set the single standard by which every megawatt Nscale builds is proven, hold the authority to accept or refuse capacity on the company’s behalf, and build a commissioning and operational readiness function that scales from a 20MW first phase to multi-gigawatt campuses without the standard slipping as volume rises.

This is a build role. The function does not yet exist in its target form — the standard, the tooling, the team and the operating model are all to be created. Our portfolio spans Norway, the UK, Finland and the United States, and the technical scope is harder than conventional colocation: closed-loop direct-to-chip liquid cooling at high rack densities, Arctic and extreme-ambient operation, high-voltage grid interfaces, on-site generation and storage, and heat-reuse obligations.

|  |
| --- |
| **What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)** |

* Author and own the Group Commissioning Execution Standard — the L0–L6 framework, test scripts, witness and evidence rules, defect taxonomy and turnover package specification — and make sure it is applied, not just published.
* Hold the acceptance gate: no system is energised, accepted or handed over anywhere in the group without your sign-off, and you hold that position under schedule and commercial pressure.
* Select, deploy and govern a single commissioning management platform so evidence, defects and progress are visible in one place across the portfolio.
* Make sure commissioning is built into every project master programme from the outset, and give early, evidence-based warning when energisation or acceptance dates are at risk.
* Work with Procurement, Legal and Delivery so acceptance criteria, witness rights, test obligations and turnover standards are written into EPC and OEM packages before they are let.
* Own the methodology for closed-loop direct-to-chip liquid cooling — CDU factory testing, secondary-loop flushing and passivation, water chemistry, per-rack flow balancing, leak detection, failover under thermal transient.
* Own high-consequence electrical testing: HV energisation sequencing with network operators, protection coordination and primary injection, black-building and utility-failure testing at full simulated load.
* Recruit, develop and retain a scarce, internationally mobile discipline — including in locations where the local specialist market is thin — and build succession so no hall depends on one individual.
* Own operational readiness and the transfer to Operations: complete as-builts and O&M, populated CMMS, spares on site, tested SOPs, EOPs and MOPs, and operations staff assessed as competent before capacity is accepted.
* Set the safe-systems-of-work regime for energisation and testing across every jurisdiction we operate in, and satisfy each local regulatory and inspection regime without running three parallel ways of working.
* Lead the commissioning relationship with tenants and their acceptance teams, and support lenders, insurers and certification bodies where commissioning evidence is a diligence item.

|  |
| --- |
| **About You (Skills / Qualifications)** |

* A substantial career in critical facilities engineering — indicatively 15+ years — including 8+ years leading commissioning at programme or portfolio level rather than on a single project.
* Owner-side or client-side accountability for accepting large-scale data centre capacity. Contractor-side commissioning leadership alone will not be enough; this role has to hold a gate against the party delivering the work.
* Personally led integrated systems testing (L5) through to acceptance on at least two hyperscale or AI data centre projects of 50MW or greater.
* Direct experience of high-density liquid-cooled deployments — direct-to-chip, CDUs, secondary loops, water chemistry — or closely adjacent depth and clear evidence of learning an unfamiliar technology quickly and rigorously.
* High-voltage and medium-voltage commissioning experience, including energisation sequencing with network operators and protection coordination.
* Built and led multi-disciplinary technical teams across borders, time zones and languages.
* Contract literacy: EPC contracting forms, acceptance and handover mechanisms, witness rights, warranty provisions and the evidentiary basis of claims.
* Experience across more than one regulatory jurisdiction, and the judgement to build one standard that satisfies several regimes rather than three parallel ones.
* A degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, or equivalent demonstrable expertise.

PA’s IT team, internally known as Group Systems, is comprised of a variety of areas that support the wider firm, consisting of four key pillars: Strategy, Architecture and Infrastructure Services; ​Enterprise Solutions; Technology and Operations​; and ​Cyber Security and Compliance​.

The successful candidate will be covered two primary areas: the security of AI (protecting the organisation's own AI systems and use of AI) and AI for security (using AI to strengthen protection, detection and response). This role will sit within Cyber Security and Compliance.

**Technical ownership of AI security tool selection and deployment**

Define requirements, run structured evaluations and proofs of concept, and judge vendor claims on evidence rather than marketing.

That means measuring detection efficacy, false positive rates, latency and operational overhead. The tool categories to cover include AI security posture management, LLM guardrails and firewalls, model and supply-chain scanning, GenAI data loss prevention, and AI-enabled SOC tooling.

They should also own the deployment itself: integration with existing SIEM, SOAR, EDR and identity tooling, architecture decisions, and making sure the tools are tuned and producing value after go-live rather than becoming shelfware.

Input to vendor risk assessments fits here too, particularly on how vendors handle your data in their own models.

**Understanding the AI threat landscape**

They need a working knowledge of AI-specific attack techniques and should be fluent in the reference frameworks, mainly the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS. Key threats include:

* Direct and indirect prompt injection
* Data and model poisoning
* Sensitive data leakage through prompts and outputs
* Model theft and extraction
* Malicious model files in the supply chain
* The growing set of risks from agentic AI, such as excessive permissions and tool misuse

They also need to understand how attackers use AI against the organisation (more convincing phishing, deepfake-enabled fraud, faster reconnaissance and exploit development) and how that changes your threat model. Shadow AI, meaning unsanctioned use of AI tools by staff, is a practical, near-term issue they should be able to discover and manage.

**Demonstrating AI in protection, detection and response**

This is where the role earns its keep with stakeholders. In protection, that might mean AI-assisted vulnerability prioritisation, secure code review, or posture analysis. In detection, it covers behavioural anomaly detection, alert triage and enrichment, and LLM-assisted threat hunting. In response, it includes AI copilots for investigation and incident summarisation, automated playbooks, and agentic response actions.

A good candidate will be clear-eyed about limits: where human-in-the-loop controls are needed, how to validate AI outputs, and how to avoid automating mistakes at speed. The ability to build or run demonstrators that show value concretely is a strong differentiator.

# Vice President, Strategic FI Partnerships (Hybrid, London, UK)

Tuesday, October 6, 2026 11:58 AM

## About Us

Planet is a leading technology company transforming payments by putting customer experience first. We offer integrated solutions that include payment processing, VAT refunds, dynamic currency conversion, and management services for merchants in the Retail and Hospitality sectors worldwide.

In recent years, we have experienced significant growth, expanding our services and global presence.

With strong private equity investors, Advent International and Eurazeo, we have the financial capital and expertise to grow our capabilities and reach through acquisitions.

Our mission is to create a world of connected commerce where payments are simple, secure, and seamless, enabling our partners to deliver exceptional experiences to their customers.

## Role Overview

The VP, Strategic FI Partnerships is responsible for leading and growing a portfolio of Planet's most strategically important financial institution partnerships.

These relationships represent some of Planet's most significant partnership-led revenue opportunities and play a critical role in Planet's growth strategy. The role requires executive-level relationship management, commercial leadership and the ability to drive complex cross-functional initiatives across multiple regions and business units.

This individual will own the commercial performance, operational delivery and long-term strategic development of these partnerships, ensuring Planet maximises growth opportunities while delivering against complex contractual, operational and commercial commitments. The role is accountable for partnerships that represent a significant proportion of Planet's strategic partnership growth opportunity and requires executive-level engagement both internally and externally.

This is a highly visible role with significant exposure to executive stakeholders. While the position has no direct reports, it requires leadership through influence across Product, Technology, Operations, Commercial, Finance, Legal and Risk teams globally.

## What You Will Do

**Lead Strategic Financial Institution Partnerships**

* Own and develop a portfolio of Planet's most commercially significant financial institution partnerships.
* Serve as Planet's senior commercial representative for assigned partners.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with executive and senior stakeholder groups across partner organisations.
* Lead strategic planning, executive governance and business review activities.
* Develop and execute long-term partnership strategies aligned to Planet's business objectives.
* Identify and deliver opportunities to increase partnership value, market reach and revenue contribution.
* Provide strategic recommendations and partnership insights to senior leadership.
* Act as the executive sponsor and escalation point for critical partnership initiatives.

**Drive Commercial Growth**

* Deliver sustainable revenue growth across assigned partnerships.
* Develop and execute joint business plans with clear commercial objectives and measurable outcomes.
* Expand partner-generated pipeline and improve conversion performance.
* Identify opportunities to introduce new products, services and capabilities within existing partner ecosystems.
* Drive expansion into new markets, customer segments and growth opportunities.
* Shape commercial strategies that maximise the long-term value of strategic partnerships.
* Monitor industry trends and market developments to ensure Planet captures emerging opportunities.

**Deliver Strategic Programmes and Agreements**

* Own the successful execution of high-value strategic agreements and commitments.
* Translate complex contractual obligations into actionable delivery plans and measurable outcomes.
* Lead large-scale cross-functional initiatives involving multiple products, business units and geographies.
* Coordinate internal stakeholders to ensure alignment, accountability and timely execution.
* Proactively identify risks, remove barriers and resolve issues that could impact delivery or partner success.
* Ensure all programmes are supported by robust governance, reporting and performance tracking.
* Maintain executive visibility of progress, risks and key decisions.

**Influence Across the Organisation**

* Act as the senior partnership lead across Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, Legal, Risk and Commercial functions.
* Align internal stakeholders around shared strategic priorities and business outcomes.
* Lead and influence without direct reporting authority.
* Represent partnership priorities within executive discussions and strategic decision-making forums.
* Drive organisational focus and investment in areas that support long-term partnership success.
* Foster strong collaboration across teams to ensure delivery against strategic objectives.

**Optimise Partnership Performance**

* Drive initiatives that improve customer acquisition, revenue generation and solution adoption.
* Support the growth of Planet's payments, acquiring and value-added services within partner portfolios.
* Establish scalable engagement models, processes and commercial frameworks.
* Monitor performance metrics and implement improvement plans where required.
* Identify opportunities to deepen existing relationships and unlock additional strategic value.
* Ensure partnerships continue to deliver meaningful commercial and competitive advantage to Planet.

**Governance and Compliance**

* Maintain oversight of partnership performance, commercial commitments and contractual obligations.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, network requirements and Planet policies.
* Maintain accurate forecasting, reporting and performance visibility.
* Support executive governance forums with clear updates, recommendations and decision points.
* Ensure effective risk management across partnership activities and strategic programmes.
* Travel internationally as required to support strategic partner relationships and initiatives.

## Who You Are

* Extensive experience managing high-value strategic partnerships within payments, financial services, fintech or related industries.
* Proven success growing revenue through complex partner ecosystems and commercially significant relationships.
* Experience engaging with executive stakeholders within large financial institutions, payment providers or enterprise organisations.
* Strong track record of leading complex commercial agreements involving multiple stakeholders, products and geographies.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive outcomes without direct authority.
* Strong commercial acumen combined with excellent strategic judgement.
* Comfortable operating in complex, international and fast-moving environments.
* Highly effective at balancing long-term strategic priorities with operational execution.
* Strong programme management, governance and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Deep understanding of payments, acquiring, merchant services, acceptance solutions or related financial technology ecosystems.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, solve complex business challenges and drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Willingness to travel internationally as required

## Why Planet

Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast-paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce.

We would love to hear from you. Apply now.

At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.

Apply for this job

## Location

London

## Location Type

On-site

***Note:** Partly is headquartered in Austin, TX with offices in London, UK, Christchurch, NZ and Auckland, NZ. Wherever you're based, we'll connect you with your nearest office for onboarding, and fly you to join the full team for our quarterly "Season Openers" (we cover travel and accommodation). If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs.*

## | Our Story

Partly's mission is to connect the world's parts and we're doing that by building the first global platform for replacement parts, starting with auto parts. Our big vision is to accelerate the world towards a sustainable future where waste is eliminated and all replacement parts are universally searchable, accessible and available to all.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we utilise bleeding-edge technology to solve challenging but exciting problems that make a huge impact in a $1.9 trillion industry. We've more than tripled our team over the last 12 months and expect to double in size again over the coming 12 months. We're a global team spanning both Europe and Australasia.

We provide a scalable digital infrastructure solution to some of the world's largest businesses and the most exciting startups. Partly's solutions are integrated across hundreds of companies globally, providing the backbone for cataloguing and managing parts online.

Our investors in Blackbird Ventures (Canva, CultureAmp etc.), Square Peg, Octopus Ventures, Icehouse, Peter Beck (Rocket Lab), Akshay Kothari (Notion Co-Founder) and Dylan Field (Figma Co-Founder).

We're continuing to build a world-class team and ensuring Partly is a place where people can do the best work of their lives. We're proud of the culture we've built at Partly, and our are lived throughout every experience.

## | This role

You own Partly's multi-site repairer groups and you carry a revenue goal on them. Not the signature, the revenue: getting sites live, getting them buying through us, and putting Repair AI into the way they work.

This is the first hire of its kind at Partly. You are the first Enterprise Account Manager, so there is no playbook and no ramp to inherit. You will work out what makes a group go from signed to ordering most of its parts through us, prove it on your own accounts, and write the motion the next people run. Do this well and this becomes a team, and you have a claim on leading it.

## | What will you do

**Get signed sites live**

* Own the go-live of every site in your book, from signature to first order, and carry the number for how many are live rather than how many are signed
* Run the rollout with each group's head office: site lists, sequencing, who trains, what the first week looks like

**Own the rollout of Repair AI**

* Own the rollout of our flagship agentic capability, across your groups. You are the person who takes it from a handful of sites to the way these businesses work.
* Run the pilots and prove the case with the customer's own data: hours out of the parts process, margin won, jobs touched. Then get it out of the pilot site and across the group
* Find the next job worth giving to an agent. You will sit closer to how a bodyshop actually runs than anyone else at Partly, and most of that day is still manual. Come back with where the next one is and the evidence for it
* Feed what breaks straight to product, in detail, so Repair AI is built against real shops rather than assumptions

**Own the commercials on your accounts**

* Carry the commercial relationship: rates, rollout commitments, renewals and the terms that come with them
* Structure deals so both sides win when adoption rises, and hold groups to what they committed to
* Escalate to the Sales Director when a group's economics do not fit the standard shape, with a proposal rather than a problem

**Build the playbook**

* Work out what makes a group go from signed to ordering, and what makes one stall. The pattern is not written down anywhere today

# Senior Backend Engineer (Data serving)

## Location

United Kingdom; Denmark; Portugal; Spain

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Remote

## Department

Data

## Deadline to Apply

October 13, 2026 at 1:00 AM PDT

OverviewApplication

## **About Pleo**

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

**Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST.  
We will not review any application before the closing date so please use this time to submit a high quality application.**

## **About the role**

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source.

## **Who you’ll be working with and reporting to**

You will report to our Senior Manager of Data & AI Products, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams.

## **What you’ll be doing**

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will:

* Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination).
* Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance.
* Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature.
* Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure.
* Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas.
* Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols.
* Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services.
* Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy.
* Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails.

To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more!

## **What you bring**

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

* Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure.
* A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs.
* Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources.
* Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning.
* Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka.
* Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based).
* AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment.
* Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two.
* The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement.
* Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments.

## **Why is this role a good fit for you**

This role is a good fit for you if:

* You are passionate about building systems that serve other engineers.
* You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements.
* You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

* You need to operate within very large and structured teams with clear hierarchy. This role sits within a small and specialist team with a lot of autonomy.
* You do not wish to be responsible for services with high availability requirements. You will be held accountable for the quality and availability of those services alongside your team.
* You prefer to be handed over clearly defined scope of work. You will be expected to define and design the solutions as much as building them.

## **How you’ll develop in this role**

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will:

* Get deep into the current state: the upstream Kotlin services the serving layer will pull from, the internal consumers already waiting on the API (Data & AI Products, GenAI Platform), and any prototype serving logic that needs to be replaced or formalised.
* Ship the first production version of the Reporting API (a defined set of endpoints with agreed contracts, versioning, and SLOs) with at least one internal consumer live against it.
* Establish the access control, tenant isolation, and row/column-level security model for the API. You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

## **Show me the benefits**

* Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
* Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
* Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis.
* 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).
* For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options.
* We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
* Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

## **The interview process**

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.
2. Core skills test: An async AI-assisted programming test to assess your coding fundamentals.
3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute chat deep diving into your experience.
4. Pleo Challenge: A 75-minute system design interview focusing on your architecture, infrastructure and problem-solving skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

* We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
* Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
* This role focuses heavily on building services for internal / external users consumption. It is absolutely critical to have extensive API design and development experience, expertise in OLAP systems and to be able to work in Kotlin. Ensure your CV reflects clearly of the actual experience you have across those areas.

## **About your application**

* **English first.** Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
* **A fair look for everyone.** Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
* **Diversity drives us.** We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
