**Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST.**  
**We will not review any applications before the closing window so please don't rush to apply and use the time to submit a high quality application.**

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Business Spend segment at Pleo. In this role, you'll help us build invoices, purchase orders, supplier invoices, cards for subscriptions and be part of Business Spend as we scale procurement to pay services. If you're excited about systems with real history and are passionate about building services that handle what a company spends to run itself, then this is the opportunity for you!

## **Who you’ll be working with and reporting to**

You’ll report to our Engineering Manager in Business Spend and work closely with teams in accounting systems and card infrastructure. Our team of 10 is highly collaborative and dedicated to invoices and vendors. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across product, design and compliance to ensure success.

## **What you’ll be doing**

As a Staff Engineer, you will:

* Partner with the Engineering Manager to own and be accountable for the whole architecture of Business Spend.
* Own significant parts of our supplier data migration, moving supplier and bank account logic out of a legacy service into a dedicated one, per customer and without downtime.
* Improve the reliability of our invoice payment flows, where roughly 2.5% of payments currently fail and every failure is a customer who can't pay a supplier.
* Turn our new vendor data model into working software, so that a supplier means the same thing across cards, invoices, and accounting.
* Help the 3 teams make consistent technical decisions, through design documents, code review, and the architecture forum, without being anyone's manager.
* Raise the people around you, through pairing, review, and writing things down clearly enough that someone in another time zone can act on them.

To put things into context, here's what's on our roadmap right now: extracting supplier management out of our legacy invoice service, meeting the ISO 20022 structured address requirements for outbound payments, and rebuilding how we model suppliers and vendors across the whole of Business Spend.

On the technical side, you can expect to work with the following stack: AWS, Github actions, Kotlin on the JVM, Kafka, Spring Boot, Gradle, Kubernetes, and Grafana for metrics, logs, and traces. Our frontend is TypeScript and React.

## **What you bring**

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

* Strong verbal communication. You can hold a room of engineers who don't share a first language and leave everyone clear on what was decided.
* Experience as the technical lead for a team spread across several countries and time zones. You adapt how you communicate rather than expecting everyone to adapt to you, and you're as effective in writing and async as you are live.
* Deep backend engineering experience in a modern statically typed language such as Java, Kotlin or TypeScript, on systems running in production at scale.
* A track record of shipping inside a legacy system that was being taken apart. Not just designing the target state, but doing the migration.
* The ability to change technical direction across teams you don't own, with specific examples of when you've done it.
* Writing that other people can act on. Design documents, decision records, migration plans that work without you in the room.
* A background in payments, fintech, accounts payable, ERP or B2B SaaS.
* Experience with event-driven systems and Kafka, and a habit of building observability into what you ship.

## **Why is this role a good fit for you**

This role is a good fit for you if:

* You want to work on a genuinely unsolved problem. How a company models its suppliers across cards, invoices, and accounting is the hardest open question in our product, and we're answering it this year.
* You want your work to be visible. The team is small enough that one person changes the outcome, and you'll see the effect on customers within weeks.
* You like being the person others come to, and you'd rather earn that through the work than be handed it in a job title.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

* You want a green field project. You'll spend a real share of your time in code you didn't write, with constraints you didn't choose.
* You want to design the target state and hand it over. Here you design it and then you build it.
* You need formal authority to get things moving. You'll need to rely on technical influence and earn trust across 3 teams.

## **How you’ll develop in this role**

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will:

* Take ownership of a major workstream in the supplier migration and carry it to production.
* Work with the Accounts Payable team to improve payment reliability and the observability behind it.
* Build the relationships across all 3 teams that make cross-team technical work possible, and grow into a larger share of the architecture direction for Business Spend.

We're committed to helping you develop your career. For this role, that means a growing share of technical direction across the segment, and a clear conversation about what the next level looks like and what it takes to get there. We'd rather have that conversation early than have you find the answer somewhere else.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

## **Show me the benefits**

* Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
* Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
* Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
* 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).
* For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
* We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
* Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

## **The interview process**

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.
2. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute experience-based conversation to deep dive into technical leadership experience, achievements and complexity you’ve been used to.
3. Core skills test: A 75-minute system-design interview with two of our engineers to deep dive into your architecture and problem solving skills.
4. Pleo challenge: A 60-minute presentation interview focusing on discussing one of your previous achievements.
5. Final interview: A 45-minute leadership interview assessing your behavioural skills and values.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a Staff Engineer, we received a total of 1258 applications but only 8 were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

* We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
* Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
* The Staff seniority level at Pleo requires to have extensive experience operating as a technical lead / owner of initiatives that have cross team / domain impact in SaaS organisations of 500+ people. We’re also looking for someone with significant experience architecting services across multiple domains (e.g. invoicing, subscription cards etc.) and with the ability to decouple complex legacy systems through an effective long-term delivery plan. If you do not have this experience, please do not apply. If you do have this experience, please ensure your CV truly reflects it.

* **English first.** Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
* **A fair look for everyone.** Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
* **Diversity drives us.** We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source.

## **Who you’ll be working with and reporting to**

* Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols.
* Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services.
* Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy.
* Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails.

### Main duties of the job

This is an exciting opportunity to lead a small team within the Radiotherapy Physics Group to deliver a cutting-edge Brachytherapy Service.

As part of this role, you will work closely with Clinical Oncologists, Radiographers, Clinical Scientists and Technologists to deliver both HDR and LDR Brachytherapy Services.Reporting to the Head of Radiotherapy Physics, you will be part of a friendly, Senior Team, contributing to strategic and technical developments within Radiotherapy Physics.

As one of the largest acute teaching Trusts in England, we offer learning and development opportunities to help you achieve the career you aspire to. UHS is rated 'Good' by the CQC and in the latest national NHS Staff Survey, we were in the top 10 acute trusts for staff engagement and for staff recommending the hospital as a place to work or receive care.

## Job description

### Job responsibilities

We currently treat both gynaecological and prostate patients with Elekta Microselectron HDR afterloader. Image guided Brachytherapy Treatments are planned using Oncentra Brachy treatment planning system and with state of the art CTMR compatible applicators enabling interstitial insertions where clinically required. GEC-ESTRO (GYN) Recommendations are fully implemented for cervix treatments. An ongoing interest in this field would be desirable.

The team also supports delivery of Iodine-125 seed prostate treatments, using Variseed Treatment Planning system.

External Beam Radiotherapy is delivered on a suite of 7 Elekta Linacs, supported by Raystation Treatment Planning System and Mosaiq.

Service development and innovation are at the core of our work and staff are encouraged to attend and present their work at National and International meetings.

While the primary focus of this role is to provide technical and managerial leadership for the brachytherapy service, we will be happy to discuss involvement in other areas of interest with potential applicants.

The successful applicant needs to be a state registered Clinical Scientist with experience to act as a Medical Physics Expert (MPE) in Brachytherapy Physics.

Registration as a Radiation Protection Advisor (in Radiotherapy) would be an advantage, but we can offer training to develop the successful candidate to support this role.

An informal visit to the department in encouraged.

The successful candidate will be responsible for leading and managing the Brachytherapy Physics service, contributing directly to Clinical treatments, training staff and implementing new developments and equipment within Brachytherapy.You will act as an MPE in Brachytherapy and take overall responsibility for delivery of the service.You will work closely with the Head of Radiotherapy Physics and Radiation Protection Advisor to ensure compliance with Regulations related to delivery of a Brachytherapy service.

Extensive experience of brachytherapy is essential for this role, together with proven management and leadership skills.Ability to work flexibly to accommodate clinical treatments is essential.

Excellent communication skills are required to reassure patients, interact with clinicians, radiographers, scientists and technologists and contribute to the strategic direction of the Radiotherapy Physics Senior Team.

There is a fantastic opportunity for a highly motivated, enthusiastic person to join the Radiotherapy Engineering team at Clatterbridge. The team is responsible for the maintenance and repair of sophisticated linear accelerators and peripheral technology used in the treatment of cancer.

We are seeking to recruit an experienced engineer, however, lesser experienced people or engineering graduates may be considered at lower grades. You must show enthusiasm for the role, aptitude for engineering, be a self-starter and eager to learn new technology.

The Liverpool site is our flagship site and is soon to operate 4 Varian Truebeam, 2 Halcyon linear accelerators, low-voltage XStrahl Orthovoltage treatment unit and Ariane Papillon unit, as well as Elekta Brachytherapy and Siemens CT services.

The Wirral site has 3 Varian Truebeam linear accelerators, and Siemens CT. It also has the Douglas Cyclotron as part of the National Centre for Eye Proton Therapy.

The Aintree site has 2 Varian Truebeam linear accelerators.

All 3 must be supported by the Engineering team and you may be asked to work at any site.

### Main duties of the job

You must be skilled at fault finding complex electronic systems and with good attention to detail, and be able to focus working under pressure. Relevant experience working on radiation equipment and/or complex, high capital value, large scale equipment, where maintaining up-time under pressure is required, is desirable. Mechanical aptitude, and computer networking/advanced IT skills would also be an advantage.

The post holder is required to be a member of the RCT for the Radiation Engineering discipline. If you do not hold this, you are welcome to apply but may be placed on Annex21 or Band 5 (depending on background) whilst obtaining the necessary competency for registration (typical timeframe to registration is 2 - 3 years for someone who hasn't worked in radiotherapy engineering before).

### ****What We've Built****

Raylo is the subscription infrastructure that enables leading electronics brands, including PlayStation, HP and Dyson, to move from one-off device sales to recurring subscription programmes that increase conversion, deepen loyalty and capture more lifetime value.

We have over $100m ARR, we’re profitable, growing fast, with over a quarter of a million subscriptions across consumers and small businesses. Customers trust us too, with a 4.5/5 Trustpilot rating from more than 20,000 reviews.

For customers, the experience is simple: subscribe to a device, get support throughout, upgrade when you want, and return it when you’re done. Behind that sits an AI-powered operating system that executes and manages device subscriptions end to end: credit and fraud decisioning, lifecycle operations, and the financing engine that enables brands to run subscription programmes at scale.

Brands can unlock a powerful new growth engine with Raylo across embedded checkout, Raylo.com and the customer app — converting more DTC customers, reaching subscription-first demand, and driving repeat upgrades that compound customer lifetime value.

AI is changing what small, ambitious teams can build. Companies that embrace it will define the next decade.

Translate business requirements into technical AI solutions that deliver measurable impact 
Model Deployment & MLOps 
Implement and manage end-to-end ML pipelines, from data ingestion to model deployment and monitoring 
Collaborate with DevOps and engineering teams to ensure scalable, reliable production deployment 
Maintain and optimize model performance, accuracy, and efficiency over time

Integrate AI capabilities into core banking, payments, and digital platforms 
Work closely with Product Managers, Architects, and Developers to embed AI into customer-facing solutions 
Support API development and microservices architecture for AI-driven features 
Data Engineering Collaboration

Work with structured and unstructured datasets across large-scale, distributed systems 
Innovation & Continuous Improvement 
Stay current with advancements in AI, GenAI, and emerging technologies 
Contribute to experimentation, prototyping, and innovation initiatives 
Identify opportunities to improve automation, efficiency, and decision-making through AI 
Qualifications
Software Architecture & Design 
Application architecture: Strong grasp of clean/hexagonal architecture, dependency injection, SOLID principles, and protocol-based interfaces. Can design well-structured Python services with clear separation of concerns, testable components, and maintainable codebases. This is not optional — the existing system follows these patterns and new code must be consistent. 
API design: Experience designing and maintaining RESTful API contracts. Understands OpenAPI specifications, versioning strategies, schema evolution, and backward compatibility. Can own the API surface that internal consumers depend on. 
System design: Distributed systems thinking — understands event-driven patterns, asynchronous communication, eventual consistency, and the trade-offs of different integration approaches. Can reason about how components interact across service boundaries. 
Data modelling: Can design domain models, define data flows between system components, and make pragmatic schema design decisions. Understands how data structures affect downstream consumers and system evolution. 
AI & LLM Application Skills 
LLM application development: Hands-on experience building production applications powered by LLMs. Must go beyond API calls — RAG pipelines, chain-of-thought reasoning, structured output parsing, multi-step workflows. Candidates who have only fine-tuned models or only called a single provider’s API do not qualify. 
Model-agnostic design: This is a sovereign AI system. The candidate must design against standardised API interfaces (OpenAI-compatible, LiteLLM, or equivalent abstraction layers), not couple to any single provider. Must understand model routing, fallback strategies, and how to build systems that can swap underlying models without application-layer rewrites. Experience limited to a single commercial API (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic) without abstraction is insufficient. 
Agentic system design: Demonstrated experience designing multi-step AI systems where the model makes decisions about what to do next. This could be via LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, custom agent loops, or any framework — the underlying patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, reflection) matter more than the tool. 
Prompt engineering depth: Can demonstrate iterative prompt development for complex tasks. Understands few-shot, chain-of-thought, XML/structured prompting, and the behavioural differences between model families and sizes. Critically, understands that prompt strategies must adapt when moving between frontier and smaller OSS models. 
Python Engineering 
Production Python: Strong async Python with FastAPI or equivalent framework. Comfortable with Pydantic for data validation, SQLAlchemy for data access, and structured logging (structlog). Writes clean, testable, well-documented code with proper type hints. This is a software engineering role that builds AI systems — not a data science role that happens to write Python. Safeguards for hallucinated tools, loops, partial completion, unsafe actions. Understands async trade-offs, batching, streaming, latency accumulation 
Engineering Qualities 
Works within existing systems: The candidate joins a substantial existing codebase and architecture. They must be comfortable reading, understanding, and extending code they did not write — not lobbying to rewrite it. 
Production mindset: Thinks about error handling, retry logic, graceful degradation, observability, and security as first-class concerns. Understands that agentic autonomy creates new failure modes that must be anticipated. 
Clear communicator: Can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. Can write clear design documents. Can articulate why an agentic approach is or is not appropriate for a given problem.

We are starting a labour optimisation programme with our Operations team, alongside FP&A and Data Science. The aim is to improve our wage percentage to sales while improving service standards at the same time. We are not interested in an approach that delivers one at the expense of the other.

* Support Finance translate demand forecasts into labour requirements, helping to build the models that turn covers, check-ins, treatments and occupancy into hours by role
* Partner with our Data Science and Operations teams to understand forecast accuracy and recommend improvements
* Connect labour deployment to member experience, so that productivity gains are demonstrably not coming out of the House

What we are looking for..

* Proven experience in labour optimisation. You have personally delivered measurable improvement in wage percentage or sales per labour hour in a multi-site operation, and can talk us through the levers you pulled, how you sized them and how you proved the result

### Technical Project Management at TEECOM

Technical Project Managers at TEECOM are the primary point of contact for client accounts — they own the relationship, the technology scope, and the delivery across multiple concurrent projects. This is a client-facing, field-active role: TPMs spend significant time on-site managing the technology scope of active projects alongside construction teams, contractors, and client stakeholders.

Work spans managing design team coordination, leading client meetings, driving construction administration, reviewing submittals and RFIs, and ensuring projects close out cleanly.

We hire at all levels — the strongest Technical Project Managers are proactive, coachable, and take ownership of client relationships and outcomes: they're as comfortable with a stakeholder as they are in the field, they don't wait for problems to find them, they own the commercial and technical outcomes of every project they run, and they're always thinking about what comes next — growing the partnership, not just closing the project.

**Information Security Officer**

  

*Are you a team player? Would you love to expand your knowledge in the security area? Do you have great organisation and time management skills? Got your interest, then look no further...*

  

**What the role has to offer:**

* Having an impact on how data is controlled and staying at the forefront of security risks
* Collaborate with all teams within the business
* Dealing with a variety of work – not one day is the same

**Our Opportunity**

You will be working within the Thales DIS UK Security organization; you will be responsible for ensuring the organizations compliance with regulatory bodies and with customers within the Banking environment.

The key objective of this role is to ensure that Thales DIS UK maintains its physical and logical accreditations by ensuring that the organisation implements and encourages security within the production facilities.

  

Some of your responsibilities will include:

  

* Control and Maintain the ISO 27001 Information Security Management System, ensuring compliance to all areas of that standard
* Maintain Security Risk Assessments of all applicable sites as required by ISO 27001
* Ensure compliance with data protection legislation.  Promoting awareness as well
* Stay up-to-date of statutory/legal changes impacting on information security, incorporating them into relevant policies and advising staff on their implementation
* Assist with internal and external audit programmes.  Ensuring compliance with the Information Security Policy and that the necessary controls are in place to satisfy
* Identify high risk issues and escalate as required
* Investigate IT related complaints and incidents in conjunctions with Security Manager, Security team, and/or other departments.  Also providing input for remedial action plans
* Closure of audit and testing non-conformities through the provision of sound remedial actions
* Work with staff to ensure that security considerations are taken into account during design and implementation
* Work with corporate teams to ensure compliance and exchange ideas
* Conduct supplier audits where necessary to ensure standards are adhered to through the supply chain
* Train employees in IT Security controls and best practice

# Senior Product Manager, CRM - MONOPOLY GO!

GB - United Kingdom

Scopely is looking for a **Senior Product Manager, CRM** to join our MONOPOLY GO! game team in our Barcelona studio on a hybrid basis (3X in office), or remotely within the UK.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

**What You’ll Do**

We’re looking for a passionate and experienced Senior Product Manager to shape how Monopoly GO! connects with players throughout their journey, solving complex product challenges and creating communication experiences that are more relevant, timely, and valuable.

As Senior Product Manager for CRM, you’ll own the vision and roadmap for the capabilities, tools, and experiences that power communication throughout the player journey. You’ll identify player and business needs, translate them into product opportunities, and lead cross-functional teams to discover, build, and continuously improve scalable CRM solutions for a leading live-service mobile game.

**Product Strategy**

* + Own and lead the CRM product roadmap and strategy across player-facing experiences and internal tooling, translating player, business, behavioural, and market insights into strategic priorities
  + Identify opportunities to improve engagement, retention, reactivation, and player value, while shaping the future of CRM across push, email, in-game messaging, Live Activities, and emerging channels
  + Champion relevant, contextual, personalised, and player-first communication experiences while serving as a senior product voice and CRM subject-matter expert across the organisation

**Roadmap, Discovery and Innovation**

* + Lead discovery and ideation to identify player needs, team pain points, and opportunities to evolve CRM, while leading a cross-functional product area with dedicated software engineering resources
  + Provide clear product direction, priorities, requirements, and success criteria to guide execution, and own delivery outcomes from discovery and prioritisation through development, launch, measurement, and iteration
  + Evolve CRM capabilities including personalisation, automation, segmentation, decisioning, orchestration, and dynamic content

**Performance and Continuous Improvement**

* + Partner with the analytics team to monitor and report on program effectiveness, using data-driven insights to recommend continuous improvement and keep players at the heart of every decision
  + Lead structured testing strategies across A/B testing, cadence, segmentation, and channel mix, while championing a strong test-and-learn culture

**What We’re Looking For**

* Proven experience in Product Management or a related product discipline
* Product experience in gaming is strongly preferred; experience in entertainment or mobile apps is also relevant
* Strong understanding of player lifecycle and contact strategy
* Analytical mindset and confidence using data to identify opportunities and guide decisions
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and comfort working in a fast-paced environment
* A player-first mindset and a drive to keep improving product and communication strategies

**Bonus Points**

* Hands-on experience with Braze or a similar marketing automation platform
* Experience with tools such as Looker
* Experience with live-service, casual, or social games

### About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star TrekTM Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

The models that drive our trading strategies have evolved considerably over the last 10 years, from econometric methods that gave our company its name, to trees, to neural networks, to modern deep learning architectures.

XTX Markets has an unrivalled level of computational resources in the trading industry, with a growing research cluster currently containing over 25,000 GPUs with 650 petabytes of usable storage. Teams across the firm include world-class researchers, developers and technologists with backgrounds in pure math, programming, physics, computer science and machine learning. The firm is also constructing a large-scale data centre in Finland to future-proof its significant computational capabilities.

At XTX Markets technology is our business and we are a diverse organization which attracts outstanding talent from across all industry backgrounds. We are focused on teamwork, and our people collaborate on all aspects of the business, working openly and with respect for each other, our clients and the market. Our culture is non-hierarchical and one where everyone is valued. We strive for excellence in everything we do.

**The Role**

As a Realtime Analytics and Controls Developer, you will be responsible for the mission control panel for one of the largest trading systems in the world ($250bn-300bn/day). Your work will have a company-wide impact, with users including Trading Desk, Trading Developers, Quants, CEO, Distribution and Risk.

The goal is to provide clarity about what our trading system (hundreds of thousands of strategies) is doing at any given moment and how it is performing. We supply both high-level and incredibly detailed views, as both are crucial for efficient decision making and spotting issues. In addition to visibility, we are also responsible for trading control mechanisms – e.g., tweaking limits, starting trading strategies or emergency stopping. These actions are necessary for continued trading, and sometimes need to be taken within minutes, with millions of pounds at stake.

Realtime Analytics and Controls is a small specialist tam which works directly with multiple front office groups. You will be expected to also contribute to the shared software platform that supports this group.

This is one of our most people-oriented engineering roles. You should expect to collaborate regularly with your colleagues who are the primary customers of your software, to understand how your design decisions affect their day-to-day work.

* Maintain calculation of trading metrics.

* Experience with binary protocols.

Cell therapies are creating new possibilities for people living with devastating diseases, but reaching more patients depends on solving one of the industry’s biggest challenges: how to manufacture these therapies reliably and at scale. At Cellular Origins, we’re building the technology and factory approach to make that possible. **About the role**

As Chief Finance Officer, you’ll be the senior financial leader for Cellular Origins and a key member of the C-suite. You’ll work closely with the CEO, leadership team and Board to shape our capital strategy, guide major decisions and help us grow as an independent, privately owned company.

You’ll bring clarity to complexity. From long-range planning and funding strategy to pricing, investment and resourcing decisions, you’ll help the team understand not just the numbers, but what they mean and how they connect to our long-term goals.

You’ll get to shape the financial foundations of a company tackling a complex manufacturing challenge with huge potential impact. You’ll combine strategic thinking with enough detail to make sure the right decisions are being made at the right time.

* Partner with the CEO and Board on funding strategy, investor reporting and scenario planning.
* Build and lead a high-performing finance team, creating the processes, tools and standards that make good decisions easier.
* Plan and manage the transition of accounting activities from our founding company, TTP.
* Develop and refine commercial models for our platform, helping ensure pricing and contracting support sustainable growth and strong customer partnerships.
* Oversee financial controls, reporting, audit and compliance, keeping the business disciplined as it grows.

# Principal, EMEA Sales Strategy and Operations

## Job Description

**About Us**

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

**Available Locations: London, the UK**

**About the Role:**

As the Principal, EMEA Sales Strategy and Operations, you will lead the operational strategy and execution for two of our most important regions in EMEA. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Sales Strategy and Operation for EMEA, you will partner closely with regional sales leadership, global sales operations, marketing, finance, and other cross-functional teams to drive sales productivity, accelerate pipeline growth, and enhance forecasting accuracy.

You will identify, design, and execute strategies that improve performance, scalability, and operational excellence across UKI, CEE and Israel regions. A catalyst for action, you will bring structure, insight, and momentum to a rapidly growing business. The ideal candidate is both process- and data-driven, thrives on collaboration, and knows how to unite teams around a common vision to deliver exceptional results.

****What you’ll do****

* **Responsibilities:**

  + Serve as a business partner to the UKI, CEE and Israel AVPs and Sales Leadership team, defining and driving strategic initiatives that enable the region to achieve its quarterly and annual revenue objectives. You will deliver actionable insights, analytics, and use AI to enhance decision-making, uncover performance bottlenecks, and accelerate sales execution
  + You will work to continuously improve processes, innovate and find scalable solutions to do more with less. You will use AI and automation to improve sales productivity and help leadership look behind corners to anticipate blockers and reduce risks.
  + Partner with other Regional Leaders, global RevOps, Marketing Ops, Finance and Enablement to ensure regional execution aligns with global go-to-market strategy and expectations
  + Drive forecasting discipline: ensure accurate pipeline coverage, risk identification, deal reviews, and business reviews with regional leadership
  + Monitor region-specific market dynamics and ensure sales operations are tailored to the unique UKI, CEE and Israel environment
  + Own key regional sales operations metrics (e.g., sales cycle length, win rate, pipeline conversion, average deal size, forecasting accuracy, quota attainment) and provide regular reporting to senior leadership and support EMEA sales Strategy and Operations leader to improve cadences.
  + Partner with GTM strategy team and provide input to sales planning, including regular updates to quotas, customer segmentation, account targeting, and Channel development

****Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:****

* Proven senior experience (10+ years) in sales operations, revenue operations or go-to-market operations in a high-growth technology / SaaS company
* Experience scaling sales operations across multiple regions (preferably EMEA) including complexity of multiple countries, languages, regulatory frameworks
* Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data: able to turn data into insights and actions
* Deep understanding of sales processes/end-to-end sales lifecycle, pipeline management best practices, forecasting, territory/quota design, incentive comp, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce)
* Experience to use AI to drive automation, innovation and improve efficiency.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills: ability to partner with sales leadership, marketing, product, finance, enablement and others
* Excellent communication (verbal & written) – able to articulate complex operational issues and influence senior leadership
* Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic, changing environment; strong change-management aptitude
* Strategic thinking with strong execution orientation

**What Makes Cloudflare Special?**

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

**Project Galileo**: Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost.

**Athenian Project**: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

**1.1.1.1**: We released1.1.1.1to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use – it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal – we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by ourprivacy commitmentand ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

* Have **1–2 years of experience** in Sales Development or Business Development in SaaS or business application technology.

* Learning & development stipend

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, and applicants in need of assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at assistance(at)zuora.com.

You’re unique and we’re on a journey – so let’s embark on a unique journey together. We encourage you to apply to all roles that utilize your skills and ignite the passion within you.

No matter where you’re located, or which team you work on, you’ll be part of a group of people working together to build a better world: The World Subscribed.
